explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词在with复合结构中的用法。with复合结构的逻辑主语是all the tasks，分析非谓语与逻辑主语的关系：任务是“被完成”的，表被动。过去分词（done）在with复合结构中表被动或完成，符合语境，故A正确。B选项现在分词finishing表主动，与逻辑主语是被动关系，排除；C选项不定式to finish在with复合结构中表将来的动作，此处任务已经完成，排除；D选项动词原形finish不能用于with复合结构，排除。
kp_name: 非谓语动词在with复合结构中的用法

content.stem: The little girl was seen ______ a letter in the garden when the police arrived.

explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词作宾语补足语的用法，核心是see的被动语态搭配。see后接宾语补足语时，主动语态中用不带to的不定式（do）表动作全过程，用现在分词（doing）表动作正在进行；被动语态中，不定式要还原to，现在分词形式不变。本题语境是“警察到达时，小女孩正在写信”，动作正在进行，故用现在分词writing作补语，A正确。B选项to write是see被动语态中表全过程的结构，此处动作正在进行，排除；C选项write是see主动语态中表全过程的结构，被动语态需还原to，排除；D选项过去分词written表被动，小女孩是主动写信，排除。
kp_name: 非谓语动词作宾语补足语

content.stem: ______ for his outstanding contributions to environmental protection, the scientist delivered a touching speech at the ceremony.

explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词作状语的时态和语态。首先分析逻辑主语是the scientist，科学家是“被授予”奖项，表被动；其次，授予奖项的动作发生在发表演讲之前，表完成。现在分词的完成被动式（having been done）可表被动且动作发生在主句动作之前，符合语境，故A正确。B选项being awarded表被动且动作与主句动作同时发生，此处奖项先授予，演讲后发表，排除；C选项to be awarded表将来的被动动作，不符合语境，排除；D选项awarding表主动，与逻辑主语是被动关系，排除。
kp_name: 非谓语动词作状语的时态语态

content.stem: Only when we fully understand the importance of environmental protection ______ take effective measures to reduce pollution.

explanation: 本题考查only修饰状语从句位于句首时的部分倒装规则。考点为only修饰状语（包括状语从句）位于句首时，主句需使用部分倒装，即把助动词、情态动词或be动词提到主语之前。题干中only修饰when引导的条件状语从句位于句首，主句需部分倒装，情态动词can应提到主语we之前，因此A选项正确。B选项未倒装，不符合规则；C选项中do和can都是助动词，不能同时使用，语法错误；D选项未倒装且do和can同时使用，语法错误。
kp_name: only修饰状语位于句首的部分倒装

content.stem: Rarely ______ such a touching story about the power of love in modern movies.

explanation: 本题考查否定副词位于句首时的部分倒装规则。考点为具有否定或半否定意义的副词（如rarely, never, seldom等）位于句首时，句子需使用部分倒装，即把助动词、情态动词或be动词提到主语之前。题干中rarely位于句首，句子需部分倒装，结合语境“在现代电影中很少看到”，应用现在完成时，助动词have应提到主语we之前，因此B选项正确。A选项未倒装，不符合规则；C选项未倒装且时态错误；D选项为全部倒装，否定副词位于句首时需部分倒装而非全部倒装，语法错误。
kp_name: 否定副词位于句首的部分倒装

content.stem: It is not until the 19th century ______ the steam engine was widely applied in industrial production.

explanation: 本题考查强调句的结构规则。考点为强调句的基本结构是“It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 句子剩余部分”，当被强调部分是时间状语、地点状语等时，连接词只能用that，不能用when、where、which等。题干中被强调部分是时间状语“not until the 19th century”，符合强调句结构，连接词用that，因此B选项正确。A选项when用于定语从句，此处不是定语从句结构；C选项which用于定语从句，指代物，不符合语境；D选项where用于定语从句，指代地点，不符合语境。

content.stem: Hardly ______ the train arrived at the station when the crowd rushed onto the platform.

explanation: 本题考查hardly...when...结构的倒装规则。考点为hardly...when...（一……就……）结构中，hardly位于句首时，主句需使用部分倒装，且主句动作发生在从句动作之前，从句用一般过去时，主句需用过去完成时。题干中hardly位于句首，主句需部分倒装，过去完成时的助动词had应提到主语之前，因此B选项正确。A选项has是现在完成时的助动词，时态错误；C选项did是一般过去时的助动词，时态错误；D选项does是一般现在时的助动词，时态错误。

content.stem: Only by practicing speaking English every day ______ your oral English proficiency to a high level.

explanation: 本题考查only修饰方式状语位于句首的部分倒装规则。考点为only修饰方式状语（如by引导的介词短语）位于句首时，主句需使用部分倒装，即把助动词、情态动词或be动词提到主语之前。题干中only修饰by引导的方式状语位于句首，主句需部分倒装，情态动词can应提到主语you之前，因此B选项正确。A选项未倒装，不符合规则；C选项未倒装且缺少情态动词，无法表达“能够”的含义；D选项使用助动词do倒装，do用于实义动词的一般现在时倒装，此处需表达“能够”的含义，应用情态动词can，因此错误。
kp_name: only修饰方式状语位于句首的部分倒装

content.stem: It was the first time that I ______ such a grand international conference, which left a deep impression on me.

explanation: 本题考查强调句中it was the first time that结构的时态规则。考点为强调句结构“It was + 被强调部分 + that...”中，若被强调部分包含“the first time”，that从句需使用过去完成时，表示“到过去某个时间为止第一次做某事”。题干中被强调部分是“the first time”，主句用一般过去时was，从句需用过去完成时，因此D选项正确。A选项attend是一般现在时，时态错误；B选项attended是一般过去时，时态错误；C选项have attended是现在完成时，用于it is the first time that结构，不符合此处it was的语境。
kp_name: it was the first time that结构的强调句时态

content.stem: Every boy and every girl in the primary school ______ required to take part in the annual sports meeting next month.

explanation: 本题考查主谓一致的特殊规则。考点为“each/every + 单数名词 + and + each/every + 单数名词”结构作主语时的主谓一致规则：该结构作主语时，谓语动词需用单数形式。题干主语为“Every boy and every girl”，符合上述结构，且时间状语“next month”表示将来，选项C（现在完成时）、D（一般过去时）时态不符，B为复数谓语，故正确答案为A。
kp_name: each/every连接的并列单数主语的主谓一致

content.stem: A series of lectures on climate change ______ been arranged for the students of the environmental science major this semester.

explanation: 本题考查主谓一致中集合名词的主谓一致规则。考点为“a series of + 复数名词”作主语时的主谓一致：该结构强调“一系列”的整体概念，谓语动词用单数形式。题干主语为“A series of lectures”，且空后为过去分词“been”，需搭配助动词构成被动语态的完成时，C、D为be动词，无法与“been”搭配，B为复数助动词，故正确答案为A。
kp_name: a series of等结构作主语的主谓一致

content.stem: Not only the manager but also the team members ______ confident that the project will be completed ahead of schedule.

explanation: 本题考查主谓一致的就近原则。考点为“not only...but also...”连接并列主语时的主谓一致规则：谓语动词的单复数形式由离它最近的主语决定。题干中离谓语最近的主语是“the team members”（复数），且宾语从句时态为一般将来时，主句需用一般现在时，A为单数谓语，C（一般过去时）、D（现在完成时）时态不符，故正确答案为B。
kp_name: not only...but also...连接并列主语的主谓一致

content.stem: The number of applicants for the position of senior engineer ______ increased by 30% compared with last year.

explanation: 本题考查主谓一致中the number of与a number of的区别。考点为“the number of + 复数名词”作主语时的主谓一致：该结构表示“……的数量”，强调整体数值，谓语动词用单数形式。题干主语为“The number of applicants”，空后为过去分词“increased”，需搭配助动词构成现在完成时，A为复数助动词，C、D为be动词，无法与“increased”构成现在完成时，故正确答案为B。
kp_name: the number of作主语的主谓一致

content.stem: Physics ______ one of the most challenging subjects for students who lack logical thinking ability.

explanation: 本题考查主谓一致中学科类名词的主谓一致规则。考点为以“-ics”结尾的学科名词作主语时的主谓一致：这类名词表示学科概念时，为单数名词，谓语动词用单数形式。题干主语“Physics”（物理）是学科名词，句子描述客观事实，需用一般现在时，A、C、D均为复数谓语或过去时态，故正确答案为B。
kp_name: 学科类名词作主语的主谓一致

content.stem: What the coach emphasized most before the game ______ the team spirit and cooperation among players.

explanation: 本题考查主谓一致中主语从句的主谓一致规则。考点为what引导的主语从句作主语时的主谓一致：谓语动词的单复数由从句所指的内容决定，若从句指单数概念，谓语用单数。题干主语从句“What the coach emphasized most”指教练强调的内容（单数概念），且“before the game”表示过去时间，谓语需用一般过去时，A为复数过去时，B（一般现在时单数）、C（一般现在时复数）时态不符，故正确答案为D。
kp_name: what引导的主语从句作主语的主谓一致

content.stem: You ______ worry about the result; the experiment has been repeated three times and all data are consistent.

explanation: 本题考查情态动词表必要性的用法。A选项needn't表示“不必”，符合语境中“实验重复三次数据一致，没必要担心结果”的逻辑；B选项mustn't表示“禁止”，语气过于强硬，不符合语境；C选项can't表示“不可能”，用于推测能力或可能性，此处不表必要性；D选项won't表示“不会”，表将来的意愿或倾向，不表必要性。
kp_name: 情态动词表必要性的用法

content.stem: The door is locked. Someone ______ have left the office without turning off the lights.

explanation: 本题考查情态动词对过去的肯定推测用法。must have done表示对过去发生的事情非常有把握的肯定推测，符合语境中“门已锁，非常确定有人没关灯就离开”的逻辑；A选项should have done表示“本应该做却没做”，含责备语气，不符合推测语境；C选项can have done一般用于否定句或疑问句表推测，不用于肯定句；D选项may have done表示对过去的不确定推测，语气弱于must，不符合“门已锁”的确定前提。
kp_name: 情态动词对过去的肯定推测用法

content.stem: I ______ have attended the meeting, but I got stuck in a traffic jam on the way.

explanation: 本题考查情态动词表过去本应做却未做的用法。should have done表示“本应该做某事却没做”，符合语境中“我本该参加会议却因堵车没去”的逻辑；A选项would have done常用于虚拟条件句的主句，表与过去事实相反的结果，此处无虚拟条件；B选项could have done表示“本能够做却没做”，侧重能力，不符合“本该参加”的语境；C选项might have done表示“本可能做却没做”，语气不确定，不符合语境。
kp_name: 情态动词表过去本应做却未做的用法

content.stem: ______ you please pass me the salt on the table?

explanation: 本题考查情态动词表请求的用法。Will you please...是固定句式，用于向对方提出委婉请求，符合语境；A选项Shall用于第一人称的请求或征求意见，不用于第二人称；C选项May用于请求许可，句式为May I...，不用于第二人称的请求；D选项Must表示“必须”，语气强硬，不用于委婉请求。
kp_name: 情态动词表请求的用法

content.stem: No one ______ enter the lab without the teacher's permission, or they will be punished severely.

explanation: 本题考查情态动词表规定、命令的用法。shall用于第三人称时，可表示规章制度中的规定、命令，符合语境中“实验室的规定”；B选项can表示“能够”，侧重能力或许可，不表规定；C选项may表示“可以”，表许可，语气弱于shall的规定性；D选项will表示“愿意、会”，表意愿或将来，不表规定。
kp_name: 情态动词表规定、命令的用法

content.stem: The light is on in the study. She ______ be reading her favorite novel there.

explanation: 本题考查情态动词对现在的肯定推测用法。must表示对现在发生的事情非常有把握的肯定推测，符合语境中“书房灯亮，非常确定她在看小说”的逻辑；A选项should表示“应该”，表责任或建议，不表推测；B选项ought to与should用法类似，表责任或建议，不表推测；D选项could表示“可能”，表不确定的推测，语气弱于must，不符合“灯亮”的确定前提。
kp_name: 情态动词对现在的肯定推测用法

content.stem: According to the passage, what is the main purpose of the new urban green space initiative launched in European cities?
options: A. To reduce urban air pollution levels significantly
B. To increase the number of public sports facilities
C. To promote the development of urban tourism
D. To raise the employment rate of local residents

explanation: 本题考查快速阅读中对文章核心目的的定位能力。正确选项A对应原文中该举措的核心定位：欧洲城市推出城市绿地计划的首要目的是缓解工业和交通带来的空气污染问题。干扰项分析：B选项（增加公共体育设施）是绿地计划的附带功能而非核心目的；C选项（促进城市旅游）是计划的潜在衍生效果，并非发起初衷；D选项（提高当地就业率）是计划实施过程中可能产生的间接影响，不是核心目的。
kp_name: 快速阅读核心目的定位

content.stem: What can we infer about the long-term impact of remote work on small town economies from the passage?
options: A. It will lead to a steady decline in small town population
B. It will bring sustainable growth to local service industries
C. It will reduce the demand for small town public transportation
D. It will cause small town housing prices to drop sharply

explanation: 本题考查快速阅读中的推理判断能力。正确选项B对应原文内容：远程办公让大量城市居民迁入小镇，带动了小镇餐饮、零售等服务业的长期增长。干扰项分析：A选项（小镇人口持续下降）与原文中人口流入的描述完全相反；C选项（降低小镇公共交通需求）不符合原文逻辑，人口增加会提升公共交通需求；D选项（小镇房价大幅下跌）与原文中房价因需求上升而上涨的内容相悖。

content.stem: Which of the following is mentioned as a major challenge faced by the global ocean plastic cleanup project?
options: A. Lack of public awareness of ocean plastic pollution
B. High cost of maintaining the cleanup equipment
C. Difficulty in sorting collected plastic waste
D. Resistance from local fishing communities

explanation: 本题考查快速阅读中对具体细节的定位能力。正确选项B对应原文：海洋塑料清理项目面临的主要挑战之一是清理设备长期在高盐高腐蚀的海洋环境中作业，维护成本极高。干扰项分析：A选项（缺乏公众意识）不符合原文，原文提到该项目获得了大量公众关注；C选项（塑料垃圾分类难）是项目的次要问题，并非主要挑战；D选项（当地渔业社区的反对）原文未提及，属于无中生有。
kp_name: 快速阅读具体细节定位

content.stem: What does the passage say about the effectiveness of the new AI-powered learning system for middle school students?
options: A. It can completely replace traditional classroom teaching
B. It helps improve students' learning efficiency by 30% on average
C. It is only suitable for students with strong self-learning ability
D. It has no significant effect on students' exam performance

explanation: 本题考查快速阅读中对数据类细节的定位与理解能力。正确选项B对应原文：研究显示，该AI学习系统能根据学生的薄弱点定制学习内容，使学生的学习效率平均提升30%。干扰项分析：A选项（完全替代传统教学）表述绝对，原文仅提到该系统是传统教学的补充；C选项（仅适合自学能力强的学生）与原文中系统能帮助基础薄弱学生的描述不符；D选项（对考试成绩无显著影响）与原文中系统提升学生成绩的内容相悖。
kp_name: 快速阅读数据类细节理解

content.stem: According to the passage, which season is the best time to visit the national park for wildflower viewing?

explanation: 本题考查快速阅读中对简单事实的定位能力。正确选项C对应原文：国家公园的野花在春季达到盛放状态，是观赏野花的最佳季节。干扰项分析：A选项（冬季）气温过低，野花无法生长；B选项（夏季）野花多已凋谢；D选项（秋季）以落叶景观为主，不是野花观赏季。
kp_name: 快速阅读简单事实定位

content.stem: What is the author's attitude towards the widespread use of facial recognition technology in public places?

explanation: 本题考查快速阅读中对作者态度的推理判断能力。正确选项B对应原文：作者既认可面部识别技术在公共安全领域的积极作用，也指出其存在隐私泄露、算法偏见等风险，认为需要完善监管后再推广，整体态度是谨慎乐观的。干扰项分析：A选项（强烈支持）忽略了作者提到的风险；C选项（完全反对）不符合作者认可技术价值的描述；D选项（漠不关心）与原文中作者深入分析技术利弊的内容完全不符。
kp_name: 快速阅读作者态度判断

content.stem: With the rapid development of digital technology, more and more traditional industries are ______ their business models to adapt to the new market environment.

explanation: 本题考查形近动词的词义辨析。A选项transforming意为“转变；改革”，代入句中表示“越来越多的传统行业正在转变其商业模式以适应新的市场环境”，符合语境；B选项transporting意为“运输”，C选项transmitting意为“传递；传播”，D选项transplanting意为“移植”，均不符合“商业模式调整”的语义逻辑，故排除。

content.stem: The research team spent three years collecting data and conducting experiments before they finally arrived at a ______ conclusion about the cause of the disease.

explanation: 本题考查形容词词义辨析及语境理解。A选项convincing意为“令人信服的”，代入句中表示“最终得出了关于该疾病病因的令人信服的结论”，符合“经过三年研究得出结论”的语境；B选项confused意为“困惑的”，C选项conservative意为“保守的”，D选项convenient意为“方便的”，均无法合理修饰“经过长期研究得出的结论”，故排除。

content.stem: Although the task seems extremely challenging at first glance, it can be divided into several small steps that are easy to ______ one by one.

explanation: 本题考查形近动词的词义辨析。A选项accomplish意为“完成；实现”，代入句中表示“可以分成几个容易逐个完成的小步骤”，符合“拆分任务降低难度”的语义；B选项accumulate意为“积累”，C选项accommodate意为“容纳；适应”，D选项accelerate意为“加速”，均无法与“小步骤”构成合理的动宾搭配，故排除。

content.stem: The local government has launched a series of policies to ______ the development of renewable energy, aiming to reduce the city's dependence on fossil fuels.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析及语境逻辑。A选项facilitate意为“促进；推动”，代入句中表示“推出一系列政策推动可再生能源的发展”，符合政府政策的目的逻辑；B选项fluctuate意为“波动”，C选项formulate意为“制定”，D选项function意为“起作用”，均无法体现“政策对能源发展的正向作用”，故排除。

content.stem: Most students find it difficult to ______ a balance between their academic studies and part-time jobs.

explanation: 本题考查固定搭配。“strike a balance”是固定短语，意为“取得平衡”，代入句中表示“大多数学生很难在学业和兼职之间取得平衡”，符合语境；B选项stroke意为“抚摸；击打”，C选项stick意为“粘贴；坚持”，D选项stretch意为“伸展；延伸”，均无法与“a balance”构成固定搭配，故排除。

content.stem: The new regulation requires all companies to ______ their environmental impact reports to the relevant department every six months.

explanation: 本题考查形近动词的词义辨析。A选项submit意为“提交；呈递”，代入句中表示“所有公司每半年向相关部门提交其环境影响报告”，符合“新规定要求”的语境；B选项subscribe意为“订阅；同意”，C选项substitute意为“替代”，D选项subordinate意为“使服从”，均不符合“向部门提交报告”的语义逻辑，故排除。

content.stem: According to the passage, what is the main challenge faced by small rural libraries in the digital age?
options: A. Insufficient funding to update digital resources
B. Lack of staff trained in digital technology
C. Low demand for digital services among local residents
D. Difficulty in maintaining traditional book collections

explanation: 本题为细节理解题，考查考生对文章具体信息的定位与理解。首先，根据题干关键词“main challenge”“small rural libraries”“digital age”定位到原文第二段：“The biggest hurdle for most small rural libraries in the digital era is the chronic shortage of funds to purchase new e-books, subscribe to digital databases and upgrade their digital service systems.” 选项A“Insufficient funding to update digital resources”是对原文“chronic shortage of funds to purchase new e-books, subscribe to digital databases and upgrade their digital service systems”的同义转述，因此正确。选项B“Lack of staff trained in digital technology”是文章中提到的次要问题，并非主要挑战；选项C“Low demand for digital services among local residents”与原文中“many residents, especially students and elderly people, are eager to access digital learning and entertainment resources”的表述相悖；选项D“Difficulty in maintaining traditional book collections”是传统时代的问题，并非数字时代的主要挑战。

content.stem: What can be inferred from the third paragraph about the impact of remote work on urban traffic?
options: A. It has completely eliminated peak-hour congestion in big cities
B. It has reduced the overall volume of commuter traffic significantly
C. It has led to a sharp rise in traffic accidents on suburban roads
D. It has made public transportation systems more profitable

explanation: 本题为推理判断题，考查考生根据原文信息进行合理推断的能力。根据题干定位到第三段：“Remote work arrangements have led to a 30% drop in the number of daily commuters traveling between residential areas and central business districts during peak hours, and traffic data shows a corresponding decline in congestion levels on major urban roads.” 选项B“It has reduced the overall volume of commuter traffic significantly”是对“a 30% drop in the number of daily commuters”的合理推断，“significantly”对应30%的降幅，因此正确。选项A“completely eliminated”表述过于绝对，原文仅提到“decline in congestion levels”，并未完全消除拥堵；选项C“sharp rise in traffic accidents on suburban roads”原文未提及，属于无中生有；选项D“made public transportation systems more profitable”与原文中“many public transit companies have reported revenue losses due to reduced passenger flow”的表述相悖。

content.stem: The author mentions the example of the honeybee in the fourth paragraph to illustrate that ____.
options: A. pollinators are highly sensitive to environmental changes
B. human activities have caused the extinction of many species
C. the loss of pollinators threatens global food security
D. ecosystems are more fragile than people generally think

explanation: 本题为例证作用题，考查考生对作者举例目的的理解。原文第四段提到蜜蜂的例子后总结：“The decline of honeybee populations is not just an ecological issue; it is a threat to the global food supply, as more than 75% of the world's food crops depend on pollination by insects.” 选项C“the loss of pollinators threatens global food security”是对该总结的同义转述，准确指出了作者举例的目的，因此正确。选项A“pollinators are highly sensitive to environmental changes”是蜜蜂例子本身体现的特点，而非作者举例的核心目的；选项B“human activities have caused the extinction of many species”原文未提及蜜蜂灭绝，仅提到种群下降，且不是举例目的；选项D“ecosystems are more fragile than people generally think”表述过于宽泛，没有紧扣作者强调的对粮食供应的影响这一核心。

content.stem: What is the author's attitude towards the widespread use of AI in education?

explanation: 本题为观点态度题，考查考生对作者整体态度的把握。原文中作者既提到AI在教育中的积极作用，如“AI-powered adaptive learning systems can provide personalized instruction to meet the diverse needs of students”，也指出了潜在问题，如“over-reliance on AI may reduce students' critical thinking abilities and social interaction skills”。选项A“Cautiously optimistic”（谨慎乐观）准确概括了作者既认可AI的价值又担忧其负面影响的态度，因此正确。选项B“Strongly critical”（强烈批判）仅强调负面，忽略了作者对AI积极作用的认可；选项C“Completely supportive”（完全支持）仅强调正面，忽略了作者的担忧；选项D“Indifferent”（漠不关心）与作者详细讨论AI利弊的内容完全不符。

content.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main idea of the passage?
options: A. The history and development of urban community gardens
B. The benefits and challenges of urban community gardens
C. How to establish a successful urban community garden
D. The role of urban community gardens in reducing food waste

explanation: 本题为主旨大意题，考查考生对文章核心内容的整体概括能力。原文首先介绍了城市社区花园的概念，接着阐述了其带来的多种好处，如“improve residents' physical and mental health, strengthen social connections, and increase access to fresh vegetables”，然后讨论了面临的挑战，如“limited space, high maintenance costs, and conflicts among participants”。选项B“The benefits and challenges of urban community gardens”全面涵盖了文章的核心内容，因此正确。选项A“The history and development”仅涉及文章的部分内容，未涵盖好处和挑战；选项C“How to establish”是文章未重点讨论的内容；选项D“The role in reducing food waste”是好处中的一个细节，不能概括全文主旨。

content.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" in the fifth paragraph most probably means ____.
options: A. something that has both advantages and disadvantages
B. a tool that is widely used in modern industries
C. a problem that is difficult to solve
D. an opportunity that is easy to miss

explanation: 本题为词义猜测题，考查考生根据上下文推断短语含义的能力。原文第五段提到“Social media is often described as a double-edged sword for teenagers”，后面紧接着解释：“On one hand, it allows them to stay connected with friends and access educational resources; on the other hand, it can lead to cyberbullying, anxiety and reduced attention spans.” 选项A“something that has both advantages and disadvantages”是对“double-edged sword”的准确解释，符合上下文语境，因此正确。选项B“a tool that is widely used in modern industries”与原文讨论的社交媒体对青少年的影响无关；选项C“a problem that is difficult to solve”仅强调负面，未体现“双刃剑”的两面性；选项D“an opportunity that is easy to miss”与原文内容不符。

content.stem: Many cities are now investing in green infrastructure to ____ air quality and reduce public health risks.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析及语境逻辑。首先分析题干语境：城市投资绿色基础设施的目的是改善空气质量、降低公共健康风险，空格处需填入表示“提升、改善”含义的动词。A选项enhance意为“提高、增强（质量、效果等）”，符合语境逻辑；B选项exploit意为“开发、剥削”，常搭配资源、机会等，与air quality搭配不当；C选项dominate意为“主导、控制”，不符合城市投资绿色设施的目的；D选项isolate意为“隔离、孤立”，与语境完全相悖。
kp_name: 动词词义辨析及语境逻辑

content.stem: The research team found that long-term exposure to blue light at night can ____ disrupt the human body’s circadian rhythm.

explanation: 本题考查副词词义辨析及语境逻辑。题干语境为“夜间长期暴露在蓝光下会扰乱人体昼夜节律”，空格处需填入体现影响程度的副词。A选项significantly意为“显著地、重大地”，符合“长期暴露”带来的严重影响的语境；B选项accidentally意为“偶然地”，与“长期暴露”的持续性矛盾；C选项temporarily意为“暂时地”，无法体现长期暴露的影响特点；D选项rarely意为“很少地”，与研究结论的表述逻辑不符。
kp_name: 副词词义辨析及语境逻辑

content.stem: Despite facing fierce competition from international brands, the local bakery has managed to ____ its loyal customer base over the past decade.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析及让步逻辑。题干中despite引导让步状语，逻辑为“尽管面临国际品牌的激烈竞争，本地面包店还是设法保留了忠实客户群”，空格处需填入表示“保留”含义的动词。A选项retain意为“保留、保持”，符合让步逻辑；B选项replace意为“替换”，C选项release意为“释放、发布”，D选项remove意为“移除”，均不符合“竞争下维持客户群”的语境逻辑。
kp_name: 动词词义辨析及让步逻辑

content.stem: The new policy requires all employees to complete a mandatory training course ____ they can apply for a promotion.

explanation: 本题考查连词词义辨析及逻辑关系。题干逻辑为“新政策要求所有员工完成强制培训课程才能申请晋升”，空格处需体现动作的先后顺序。A选项before意为“在……之前”，符合“先完成培训，再申请晋升”的先后逻辑；B选项unless意为“除非”，代入后逻辑为“除非申请晋升才完成培训”，与政策要求相悖；C选项while意为“当……时”，无法体现先后顺序；D选项since意为“自从、因为”，代入后逻辑不通。
kp_name: 连词词义辨析及逻辑关系

content.stem: It is widely accepted that regular exercise is ____ to maintaining good physical and mental health.

explanation: 本题考查形容词词义辨析及常识逻辑。题干语境为“普遍认为规律运动对维持身心健康是____的”，根据常识，规律运动对健康是有益的。A选项beneficial意为“有益的”，符合常识逻辑；B选项harmful意为“有害的”，C选项costly意为“昂贵的”，D选项useless意为“无用的”，均与常识及语境相悖。
kp_name: 形容词词义辨析及常识逻辑

content.stem: The professor emphasized that critical thinking is an essential skill for students to ____ complex information and form independent judgments.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析及语境逻辑。题干语境为“教授强调批判性思维是学生____复杂信息并形成独立判断的核心技能”，空格处需填入与“批判性思维”“复杂信息”匹配的动作。A选项analyze意为“分析”，符合批判性思维处理复杂信息的逻辑；B选项imitate意为“模仿”，与批判性思维的内涵不符；C选项memorize意为“记忆”，无法体现批判性思维的核心；D选项summarize意为“总结”，是分析后的后续动作，不能直接体现处理复杂信息的核心动作。
kp_name: 动词词义辨析及语境逻辑

content.stem: Many small businesses struggle to ______ cash flow during the first year of operation.

explanation: 本题考查近义动词的词义辨析。考点为商务场景下动词的固定搭配与语义区分。A选项maintain意为“维持，保持”，maintain cash flow是商务领域的固定搭配，意为“维持现金流”，符合语境；B选项remain是不及物动词，后接名词时需加介词in，且语义侧重“仍然是”，不符合搭配要求；C选项reserve意为“预留，储备”，侧重提前留存资源，不符合“维持运营期间现金流”的语境；D选项retain意为“保留，留住”，侧重不失去已有事物，语义不如maintain贴合“持续维持运营所需现金流”的核心含义。

content.stem: The research team is ______ to publish their findings before the international conference next month.

explanation: 本题考查情感类形容词的语义差异与语境适配。考点为形容词的情感倾向与语境逻辑。A选项eager意为“渴望的”，侧重积极期待；B选项anxious意为“急切的，焦虑的”，既包含渴望的情绪，也隐含因赶截止日期产生的压力，符合“赶在国际会议前发表成果”的语境；C选项keen后接动词时需加介词on，不符合语法搭配；D选项urgent意为“紧急的”，用于描述事物的紧迫性，不能修饰人，语义和语法均不匹配。
kp_name: 情感类形容词语义辨析

content.stem: The new policy is designed to ______ the gap between urban and rural educational resources.

explanation: 本题考查固定搭配与动词的抽象语义。考点为抽象语境下的动词固定搭配。A选项bridge意为“弥合，消除”，bridge the gap是固定搭配，意为“弥合差距”，符合“缩小城乡教育资源差距”的语境；B选项link、C选项connect均意为“连接”，侧重物理或逻辑上的连接，不能与gap搭配表达“缩小差距”的含义；D选项associate意为“关联，联系”，侧重事物之间的相关性，语义不贴合语境。

content.stem: It is widely ______ that regular exercise can improve both physical and mental health.

explanation: 本题考查被动语态下的动词搭配。考点为it作形式主语的固定句式。A选项accepted意为“认可，接受”，It is widely accepted that...是固定句式，意为“人们普遍认为……”，符合语境；B选项received意为“收到”，语义侧重“接收”，不用于表达观点的认可；C选项agreed的主语通常为人，不能用于该被动句式；D选项allowed意为“允许”，语义侧重许可，不符合语境。
kp_name: 固定句式与被动语态动词搭配

content.stem: The sudden change in weather forced the organizers to ______ the outdoor concert.

explanation: 本题考查事件类动词的语义差异。考点为突发状况下的事件处理动词辨析。A选项cancel意为“取消”，侧重终止原本计划的活动；B选项postpone和C选项delay均意为“推迟”，侧重活动改期而非终止；D选项suspend意为“暂停”，侧重活动中途中断，未来可能恢复。根据“天气突变”的突发语境，组织者通常会直接终止无法进行的活动，因此cancel最符合语境。

content.stem: The novel explores the ______ of identity in a multicultural society.

explanation: 本题考查抽象名词的语义辨析。考点为文学语境下的抽象名词理解。A选项complexity意为“复杂性”，侧重事物内在的复杂属性；B选项complication意为“并发症，复杂情况”，侧重额外出现的麻烦；C选项confusion意为“困惑”，侧重认知层面的混乱；D选项conflict意为“冲突”，侧重对立矛盾。根据“多元文化社会中身份”的语境，小说通常探讨身份的内在复杂性，因此complexity最符合语境。

content.stem: The study found that regular moderate exercise can significantly ______ the risk of developing chronic diseases such as diabetes and heart disease.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析及语境逻辑。题干意为“研究发现规律的适度运动能显著______患糖尿病、心脏病等慢性病的风险”。A选项reduce意为“降低，减少”，符合“适度运动对健康有益”的逻辑，即降低患病风险；B选项produce意为“产生”，代入后意为“产生风险”，与运动的健康属性矛盾；C选项promote意为“促进，提升”，代入后意为“提升风险”，同样不符合运动的健康意义；D选项increase意为“增加”，代入后逻辑完全相反，因此正确答案为A。

content.stem: In order to adapt to the new work environment, the young employee has made great efforts to improve his professional skills and ______ with his colleagues.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析及语境逻辑。题干意为“为了适应新的工作环境，这位年轻员工努力提升专业技能，并与同事______”。A选项cooperate意为“合作”，符合职场适应的合理行为逻辑，即提升技能的同时与同事合作；B选项compete意为“竞争”，仅强调对抗，未体现适应环境的正向行为；C选项compare意为“比较”，代入后语义不通；D选项complain意为“抱怨”，是负面行为，与“努力适应”的语境矛盾，因此正确答案为A。

content.stem: The old library, which was built in the early 20th century, is now under ______ to preserve its historical features.

explanation: 本题考查名词词义辨析及语境逻辑。题干意为“这座建于20世纪初的旧图书馆目前正在______，以保留其历史特色”。A选项renovation意为“修缮，翻新”，符合“保留历史特色”的目的逻辑；B选项destruction意为“破坏”，代入后语义完全相反；C选项expansion意为“扩建”，扩建通常会改变原有建筑的规模，与“保留历史特色”的目的不符；D选项decoration意为“装饰”，仅侧重外观美化，未体现对历史建筑的保护性修缮，因此正确答案为A。

content.stem: Although the project is extremely challenging, the team is ______ confident that they can complete it on schedule.

explanation: 本题考查逻辑副词的用法及语境逻辑。题干意为“尽管这个项目极具挑战性，团队______有信心按时完成”。A选项nonetheless意为“尽管如此，仍然”，体现转折逻辑，符合“挑战大但仍有信心”的语义关系；B选项therefore意为“因此”，表因果逻辑，代入后逻辑不通；C选项moreover意为“此外”，表递进逻辑，不符合语境；D选项otherwise意为“否则”，表条件逻辑，代入后语义矛盾，因此正确答案为A。

content.stem: Many people prefer to shop online because it is more ______ than going to physical stores.

explanation: 本题考查形容词词义辨析及语境逻辑。题干意为“很多人喜欢网购，因为它比去实体店更______”。A选项convenient意为“方便的”，是网购的典型优势，符合语境；B选项expensive意为“昂贵的”，是网购的潜在劣势，与“喜欢网购”的原因矛盾；C选项dangerous意为“危险的”，不符合网购的普遍属性；D选项difficult意为“困难的”，同样与“喜欢网购”的原因矛盾，因此正确答案为A。

content.stem: The scientist's groundbreaking research has ______ a new era in the field of renewable energy.

explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析及语境逻辑。题干意为“这位科学家的突破性研究______可再生能源领域的新时代”。A选项ushered in意为“开启，开创”，符合“突破性研究开启新时代”的语义逻辑；B选项broken down意为“分解，出故障”，代入后语义不通；C选项turned out意为“结果是，证明是”，代入后不符合语境；D选项set off意为“出发，引爆”，与“新时代”搭配不当，因此正确答案为A。

content.stem: What is the main idea of the passage about urban community gardens?
options: A. Urban community gardens provide multiple benefits for residents and cities.
B. Urban community gardens can help reduce the cost of fresh vegetables.
C. Urban community gardens are a popular activity for elderly residents.
D. Urban community gardens need more government financial support.

explanation: 本题考查主旨理解，核心是识别文章的核心观点而非局部细节。正确选项A涵盖了文章提到的所有核心内容，包括居民层面的社交互动、健康改善，以及城市层面的生态效益、社区凝聚力等，是对全文的全面概括。干扰项B仅对应文章中提到的‘降低居民蔬菜成本’这一个局部细节，属于以偏概全；干扰项C仅涉及‘老年居民参与’这一局部内容，无法覆盖全文主旨；干扰项D仅对应文章末尾提到的‘需要政府支持’这一补充建议，并非文章的核心论述对象，因此均不适合作为主旨。

content.stem: What is the main purpose of the passage discussing the impact of remote work?
options: A. To analyze the dual effects of remote work on employees and enterprises.
B. To compare the productivity of remote work and in-office work.
C. To advise companies on how to manage remote work teams effectively.
D. To explain the reasons for the rapid rise of remote work post-pandemic.

explanation: 本题考查主旨理解，核心是判断文章的核心论述目的。正确选项A涵盖了文章的核心内容：既分析了远程工作对员工的影响（如工作与生活平衡、社交隔离），也分析了对企业的影响（如运营成本降低、团队管理难度增加），是对全文论述目的的准确概括。干扰项B仅对应文章中‘远程工作与办公室工作的生产率对比’这一个局部内容，属于细节而非核心目的；干扰项C仅对应文章末尾提到的‘企业管理建议’这一补充内容，并非文章的核心论述方向；干扰项D仅涉及‘远程工作兴起的原因’这一开篇背景介绍，无法覆盖全文的核心论述内容，因此均不适合作为主旨。

content.stem: What is the central argument of the passage about animal-assisted therapy for mental health?
options: A. Animal-assisted therapy is a valuable complementary approach for mental health treatment.
B. Dogs are the most suitable animals for assisting in mental health therapy.
C. Animal-assisted therapy can cure common mental health disorders like anxiety.
D. Animal-assisted therapy is more effective than traditional mental health counseling.

explanation: 本题考查主旨理解，核心是识别文章的核心论点。正确选项A准确概括了文章的核心观点：文章通过多项研究数据证明动物辅助治疗对心理健康的积极作用，同时明确指出其定位是‘辅助治疗手段’，而非替代传统治疗，表述严谨且覆盖全文核心。干扰项B仅对应文章中提到的‘狗是最常用的治疗动物’这一局部细节，属于以偏概全；干扰项C的‘治愈（cure）’表述过于绝对，文章仅提到‘缓解症状、改善状态’，并未声称可以治愈疾病，属于过度推断；干扰项D的‘比传统咨询更有效’与文章内容不符，文章仅说明其作为补充手段的价值，未进行有效性对比，因此均不适合作为主旨。

content.stem: What is the main theme of the passage about the evolution of public libraries?
options: A. Public libraries have transformed from book storage spaces to community service hubs.
B. Public libraries are facing the challenge of declining visitor numbers in the digital age.
C. Public libraries should expand their digital collections to attract more young people.
D. Public libraries play an important role in promoting equal access to knowledge.

explanation: 本题考查主旨理解，核心是识别文章的核心主题。正确选项A准确概括了文章的核心发展脉络：从早期公共图书馆‘仅提供书籍借阅’的单一功能，到现在‘提供数字资源、职业培训、儿童活动、社区聚会空间’的多元服务，完整呈现了公共图书馆的功能演变，是对全文主题的准确概括。干扰项B仅对应文章中提到的‘数字时代面临的挑战’这一局部内容，属于细节而非核心主题；干扰项C仅涉及‘吸引年轻人的具体建议’这一补充内容，无法覆盖全文的核心发展脉络；干扰项D仅对应公共图书馆的核心价值之一，未体现文章重点论述的‘演变’过程，因此均不适合作为主旨。

content.stem: What is the main topic of the passage about the benefits of regular exercise?
options: A. The various physical and mental benefits of regular exercise.
B. How to design a suitable exercise plan for beginners.
C. The best time of day to do regular exercise.
D. The common mistakes people make when exercising regularly.

explanation: 本题考查主旨理解，核心是识别文章的核心论述主题。正确选项A涵盖了文章提到的所有核心内容，包括运动对身体的好处（如增强免疫力、控制体重）和对心理的好处（如缓解压力、改善情绪），是对全文主题的全面概括。干扰项B仅对应文章中‘新手运动计划’这一个局部细节，属于以偏概全；干扰项C仅涉及‘最佳运动时间’这一局部内容，无法覆盖全文主旨；干扰项D仅对应文章末尾提到的‘运动常见误区’这一补充内容，并非文章的核心论述对象，因此均不适合作为主旨。

content.stem: What is the main conclusion of the passage discussing the impact of social media on adolescent identity formation?
options: A. Social media has complex, context-dependent effects on adolescent identity formation.
B. Social media helps adolescents explore different identities more freely than before.
C. Social media leads to higher rates of identity confusion among adolescents.
D. Social media should be restricted to protect adolescents' identity development.

explanation: 本题考查主旨理解，核心是识别文章的核心结论。正确选项A准确概括了文章的核心结论：文章通过多维度研究发现，社交媒体对青少年身份认同的影响并非单一，既存在‘帮助探索多元身份’的积极作用，也存在‘引发身份焦虑、认知偏差’的消极作用，且影响程度因青少年的使用方式、家庭环境等因素而异，是对全文结论的严谨概括。干扰项B仅对应文章中提到的‘积极影响’这一个局部内容，属于以偏概全；干扰项C仅涉及‘消极影响’这一局部内容，无法覆盖全文的复杂结论；干扰项D的‘应该限制’属于过度推断，文章仅客观分析影响，未提出具体政策建议，因此均不适合作为主旨。

content.stem: The main idea of the passage is that small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) play a critical role in driving regional economic growth by creating job opportunities, promoting innovation, and fostering market competition, ____ their limited access to financial resources and policy support.

explanation: 本题考查逻辑衔接词的辨析及主旨语境下的逻辑判断。首先分析句子逻辑：前半部分强调中小企业对区域经济增长的关键作用，后半部分指出其面临的融资和政策支持不足的劣势，前后为让步转折关系，即“尽管有劣势，仍发挥关键作用”。A选项despite意为“尽管”，引导让步状语，符合逻辑；B选项because（因为）、C选项since（因为/自从）均引导原因状语，表因果关系，不符合前后转折的逻辑；D选项unless（除非）引导条件状语，表假设条件，也不符合语境。

content.stem: The passage primarily focuses on analyzing the impact of remote work on employees' work-life balance, productivity, and mental health, with a particular emphasis on how flexible work arrangements can be optimized to ____ the benefits of remote work while minimizing its potential drawbacks.

explanation: 本题考查动词辨析及主旨语境下的语义匹配。句子核心是探讨如何优化灵活工作安排，后半部分的while表对比，即“最大化远程工作的好处，同时最小化其潜在弊端”，前后形成对应逻辑。A选项maximize意为“最大化”，符合“优化安排以放大好处”的主旨逻辑；B选项minimize（最小化）与后文的minimizing重复且语义矛盾；C选项maintain（维持）仅表示保持现有状态，未体现“优化”的目的；D选项ignore（忽视）不符合“优化”的正向导向，逻辑不通。

content.stem: A common theme running through the passage is that traditional education systems often fail to adapt to the rapid changes of the digital age, and therefore there is an urgent need to reform curricula to better prepare students for ____ job markets and technological advancements.

explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析及主旨语境下的语义匹配。句子主旨围绕“传统教育无法适应数字时代的快速变化”展开，因此改革课程的目的是让学生适应“快速变化的”就业市场和技术发展。A选项dynamic意为“动态的、变化的”，符合数字时代就业市场的特征；B选项stable（稳定的）、C选项predictable（可预测的）均与“快速变化”的语境矛盾；D选项traditional（传统的）与数字时代的背景不符，也不符合改革的目的。

content.stem: The passage argues that urban green spaces are not merely recreational facilities but essential components of urban ecosystems that contribute to air purification, temperature regulation, and biodiversity conservation, thus ____ the overall quality of life of urban residents.

explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词辨析及主旨语境下的逻辑推导。句子前半部分指出城市绿地的生态作用，thus（因此）表结果，即这些生态作用最终会“提升”城市居民的生活质量。A选项enhancing意为“提升、增强”，符合因果逻辑；B选项reducing（降低）语义与正向的生态作用矛盾；C选项maintaining（维持）仅表示保持现有水平，未体现生态作用带来的积极结果；D选项assessing（评估）是动作而非结果，不符合thus引导的结果状语逻辑。

content.stem: The main purpose of the passage is to ____ the importance of protecting wild animals and their natural habitats, as the loss of biodiversity will have severe consequences for the entire planet's ecological balance.

explanation: 本题考查动词辨析及主旨语境下的语义匹配。句子后半部分指出生物多样性丧失的严重后果，因此文章的主要目的是“强调”保护野生动物及其栖息地的重要性。A选项emphasize意为“强调”，符合语境；B选项deny（否认）、C选项ignore（忽视）、D选项criticize（批评）均与“指出严重后果”的正向导向矛盾，逻辑不通。

content.stem: The passage concludes that while artificial intelligence (AI) brings unprecedented efficiency and innovation to various industries, its widespread application also raises ethical concerns related to data privacy, algorithm bias, and job displacement, ____ a need for comprehensive regulation to balance its benefits and risks.

explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词辨析及主旨语境下的逻辑推导。句子前半部分指出AI的优势和带来的伦理问题，后半部分说明这些问题凸显了“平衡利弊的监管需求”。A选项highlighting意为“凸显、强调”，符合“指出问题后引出监管需求”的逻辑；B选项downplaying（淡化）与“伦理问题的严重性”矛盾；C选项resolving（解决）表示解决问题，而非引出需求；D选项creating（创造）虽有“产生”的含义，但“凸显需求”更能体现问题与监管的关联，highlighting更贴合主旨语境下的语义侧重。

content.stem: A recent study published in the Journal of Environmental Science found that urban green spaces reduce residents' stress levels by an average of 19% within six months of regular use, and the effect is 12% stronger for people living within 500 meters of the green space than for those living more than 1 kilometer away. What can be inferred from the study?
options: A. The closer residents live to urban green spaces, the more significant stress reduction they may get.
B. All residents using urban green spaces regularly will see a 19% drop in stress levels.
C. Urban green spaces can reduce residents' stress by 31% for those living within 500 meters.
D. The stress reduction effect of green spaces lasts for more than six months after regular use.

explanation: 本题考查细节推断能力。A选项正确，原文提到“the effect is 12% stronger for people living within 500 meters of the green space than for those living more than 1 kilometer away”，可合理推断出距离城市绿地越近，减压效果可能越显著。B选项错误，原文是“reduce residents' stress levels by an average of 19%”，是平均水平而非所有人都达到19%的降幅。C选项错误，原文仅说明500米内的人群减压效果比1公里外的强12%，未给出具体数值，无法得出31%的结论。D选项错误，原文未提及减压效果在六个月后是否持续。

content.stem: Many small towns in the U.S. have started to attract remote workers by offering cash grants of up to $10,000, free co-working space, and tax breaks. Local officials say this strategy not only boosts local economies by increasing consumer spending but also helps fill vacant housing units left by young people who moved to big cities for work. What can be inferred about the remote worker attraction strategy?
options: A. It is mainly designed to encourage young people to move back to their hometowns.
B. It may help solve the problem of housing vacancy in some small U.S. towns.
C. It has led to a significant increase in consumer spending in all U.S. small towns.
D. It is the most effective way for small towns to reverse population decline.

explanation: 本题考查细节推断能力。B选项正确，原文提到“helps fill vacant housing units left by young people who moved to big cities for work”，可推断该策略可能帮助解决部分美国小镇的住房空置问题。A选项错误，原文未提及该策略主要目的是吸引年轻人返乡，仅提到空置住房是年轻人迁出留下的。C选项错误，原文是“boosts local economies by increasing consumer spending”，未说所有小镇的消费支出都大幅增长。D选项错误，原文未提及该策略是扭转人口下降的最有效方式，表述绝对。

content.stem: A 2023 survey of college students' reading habits shows that 68% of respondents prefer e-books for academic reading, citing ease of search and portability as the top reasons. However, 72% of students say they prefer physical books for leisure reading, noting that physical books help them focus better and reduce screen fatigue. What can be inferred from the survey?
options: A. Most college students read both e-books and physical books for different purposes.
B. Screen fatigue is the main reason students choose e-books for academic reading.
C. The majority of college students read more e-books than physical books in total.
D. E-books are more suitable for leisure reading than physical books for most students.

explanation: 本题考查细节推断能力。A选项正确，原文显示68%的学生学术阅读偏好电子书，72%的学生休闲阅读偏好纸质书，可推断大多数大学生会因不同目的阅读电子书和纸质书。B选项错误，原文提到选择电子书的原因是易搜索和便携，屏幕疲劳是选择纸质书休闲阅读的原因。C选项错误，原文未提及两类书籍的阅读总量对比，无法推断。D选项错误，原文明确大多数学生休闲阅读偏好纸质书，与选项表述相反。

content.stem: Researchers found that bees exposed to common pesticides have a 30% lower ability to recognize flower scents, which reduces their foraging efficiency by 25%. The study also found that bees with impaired scent recognition are 40% more likely to be preyed on by spiders, as they spend more time searching for flowers and are less alert to predators. What can be inferred from the study?
options: A. Pesticides can indirectly increase bees' risk of being preyed on by predators.
B. Bees' foraging efficiency is only affected by their ability to recognize flower scents.
C. Spiders are the main predator of bees exposed to common pesticides.
D. Bees with normal scent recognition will never be preyed on by spiders.

explanation: 本题考查细节推断能力。A选项正确，原文提到接触农药的蜜蜂气味识别能力受损，导致觅食时更易被蜘蛛捕食，可推断农药会间接增加蜜蜂被天敌捕食的风险。B选项错误，原文仅说明气味识别能力会影响觅食效率，未提及是唯一影响因素。C选项错误，原文仅提到气味识别受损的蜜蜂更易被蜘蛛捕食，未说明蜘蛛是主要天敌。D选项错误，原文未提及气味识别正常的蜜蜂不会被蜘蛛捕食，表述绝对。

content.stem: Many museums around the world have started to offer free admission for one day a week, aiming to attract more visitors who cannot afford regular ticket prices. A report shows that museums with free admission days see a 40% increase in total annual visitors, and 22% of these new visitors become regular paying visitors after experiencing the museum's collections. What can be inferred from the report?
options: A. Free admission days can help museums expand their regular visitor base.
B. Most visitors to museums with free admission days come for the free entry.
C. Museums' total annual revenue increases after offering free admission days.
D. Free admission days are the most effective way to attract new visitors to museums.

explanation: 本题考查细节推断能力。A选项正确，原文提到免费开放日带来的新访客中有22%成为常规付费访客，可推断免费开放日能帮助博物馆扩大常规访客群体。B选项错误，原文未提及大多数访客是为免费入场而来。C选项错误，原文仅提到访客数量增加，未提及总收入变化，无法推断。D选项错误，原文未提及免费开放日是吸引新访客的最有效方式，表述绝对。

content.stem: A study on remote work found that employees who work from home three or more days a week report 15% higher job satisfaction than those who work in the office full-time. However, remote workers also report a 20% higher rate of work-life conflict, as they often struggle to separate work tasks from personal life. What can be inferred from the study?
options: A. Remote work has both advantages and disadvantages for employees' well-being.
B. Employees who work in the office full-time have no work-life conflict.
C. The majority of employees prefer working from home to working in the office.
D. Working from home two days a week leads to the highest job satisfaction.

explanation: 本题考查细节推断能力。A选项正确，原文提到远程工作的员工工作满意度更高，但工作与生活冲突的比例也更高，可推断远程工作对员工福祉既有优势也有劣势。B选项错误，原文仅提到远程工作者工作与生活冲突比例更高，未说全职办公室工作者没有该冲突。C选项错误，原文未提及大多数员工的偏好，无法推断。D选项错误，原文未提及每周在家工作两天的情况，无法推断其工作满意度最高。

content.stem: Many people underestimate the impact of regular exercise on mental health, but studies show that even a 20-minute daily walk can significantly reduce symptoms of ____ like anxiety and depression.

explanation: 本题考查上下文逻辑推断与词汇辨析。题干中提到的"anxiety and depression（焦虑和抑郁）"属于心理类问题，因此需要选择与之匹配的词汇。A选项"psychological disorders（心理障碍）"符合语境；B选项"physical disabilities（身体残疾）"、C选项"chronic diseases（慢性疾病）"、D选项"social conflicts（社会冲突）"均与题干中提到的心理症状无关，属于不合理干扰项。
kp_name: 上下文逻辑推断与词汇辨析

content.stem: To improve the efficiency of the manufacturing process, the company decided to ____ outdated equipment with advanced automated systems that can operate 24 hours a day.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析与语境逻辑。题干中提到"outdated equipment（过时设备）"和"advanced automated systems（先进自动化系统）"，核心动作是用新系统替换旧设备。A选项"replace（替换）"符合语境；B选项"repair（修理）"仅指修复旧设备，未体现新旧更替；C选项"reserve（保留）"、D选项"restore（恢复）"均与题干中更换设备的目的矛盾，属于不合理干扰项。
kp_name: 动词词义辨析与语境逻辑

content.stem: The research team emphasized that their findings are ____ to the specific population studied, and further research is needed to generalize the results to other age groups.

explanation: 本题考查形容词词义辨析与逻辑转折。题干中"and further research is needed to generalize the results（需要进一步研究推广结果）"暗示现有结果仅适用于特定群体。A选项"limited（局限于）"符合逻辑；B选项"applicable（适用的）"、C选项"relevant（相关的）"、D选项"similar（相似的）"均未体现结果的局限性，与题干的转折逻辑矛盾，属于不合理干扰项。
kp_name: 形容词词义辨析与逻辑转折

content.stem: When preparing for a job interview, it is important to research the company’s background and ____ to show the interviewer that you are genuinely interested in the position.

explanation: 本题考查名词词义辨析与语境逻辑。题干中"show the interviewer that you are genuinely interested（向面试官证明你真的感兴趣）"暗示需要了解公司的内在特质。A选项"values（价值观）"符合语境；B选项"salaries（薪资）"、C选项"locations（地点）"、D选项"sizes（规模）"均为表面信息，无法体现对公司的真正兴趣，属于不合理干扰项。
kp_name: 名词词义辨析与语境逻辑

content.stem: Despite the ____ of renewable energy sources like solar and wind power, their widespread adoption is still hindered by high initial costs and inconsistent supply.

explanation: 本题考查名词词义辨析与让步逻辑。题干中"Despite（尽管）"引导让步状语，后半句提到可再生能源的普及受成本和供应问题阻碍，因此前半句应描述其积极特质。A选项"advantages（优势）"符合让步逻辑；B选项"challenges（挑战）"、C选项"limitations（局限性）"、D选项"complexities（复杂性）"均为消极特质，与让步逻辑矛盾，属于不合理干扰项。
kp_name: 名词词义辨析与让步逻辑

content.stem: The new policy aims to ____ the gap between urban and rural education resources by allocating more funds to build schools and train teachers in remote areas.

explanation: 本题考查动词词义辨析与语境逻辑。题干中"allocating more funds to build schools and train teachers（投入更多资金建学校、培训教师）"的目的是缩小城乡教育资源差距。A选项"narrow（缩小）"符合语境；B选项"widen（扩大）"与政策目的完全相反；C选项"bridge（弥合）"通常与"gap"搭配，但侧重消除差距，题干中仅提到投入资金，未达到完全消除的程度；D选项"cross（跨越）"无法与"gap"搭配表达缩小差距的含义，属于不合理干扰项。
kp_name: 动词词义辨析与语境逻辑

content.stem: 中国的春节是家人团聚、庆祝新年的最重要的传统节日之一。

answer: The Spring Festival in China is one of the most important traditional festivals for family reunion and celebrating the New Year.
explanation: 本题考查核心结构“one of + the + 形容词最高级 + 名词复数”的用法，该结构表示“……中最……之一”，是四级翻译高频考点。翻译时需注意：1. “家人团聚”译为family reunion，为固定搭配；2. “庆祝新年”译为celebrating the New Year，与“家人团聚”并列作介词for的宾语，需保持动名词形式一致；3. 整体语序符合英文表达习惯，避免中式英语直译。
kp_name: one of + the + 形容词最高级 + 名词复数结构

content.stem: 剪纸是中国民间艺术的一种形式，常用于装饰门窗。

answer: Paper-cutting is a form of Chinese folk art, which is often used to decorate doors and windows.
explanation: 本题考查非限制性定语从句的用法，用于补充说明先行词的附加信息。翻译时需注意：1. “剪纸”译为paper-cutting，为固定译法；2. “民间艺术”译为folk art，是四级核心词汇；3. 用which引导非限制性定语从句修饰先行词paper-cutting，体现“常用于装饰门窗”的补充逻辑，避免将两个独立谓语直接并列，符合英文语法规则。

content.stem: 随着社会的发展，越来越多的人开始重视传统节日的文化内涵。

answer: With the development of society, more and more people have begun to attach importance to the cultural connotation of traditional festivals.
explanation: 本题考查介词短语作伴随状语和固定动词短语的用法。翻译时需注意：1. “随着社会的发展”译为With the development of society，为四级翻译高频伴随状语结构；2. “重视”译为attach importance to，是四级核心固定短语，不可误译为pay attention to（pay attention to侧重“注意”，与“重视”语义有差异）；3. “文化内涵”译为cultural connotation，为准确表达文化类内容的固定译法。
kp_name: 伴随状语与固定动词短语

content.stem: 中国的茶文化历史悠久，不仅包括饮茶的习俗，还包含茶道的哲学思想。

answer: Chinese tea culture has a long history, which not only includes the custom of drinking tea but also contains the philosophical ideas of tea ceremony.
explanation: 本题考查并列结构和文化类词汇的准确翻译。翻译时需注意：1. “茶文化”译为tea culture，“茶道”译为tea ceremony，均为中国文化类固定译法；2. “不仅……还……”译为not only...but also...，连接两个并列的谓语动词includes和contains，保持结构一致；3. “哲学思想”译为philosophical ideas，准确体现文化内涵，避免误译为philosophical thoughts（thought侧重“个人想法”，ideas更适合表达体系化的思想）。
kp_name: 并列结构与文化类词汇翻译

content.stem: 许多传统手工艺面临失传的风险，因此政府采取了一系列措施来保护和传承这些文化遗产。

answer: Many traditional handicrafts are at risk of being lost, so the government has taken a series of measures to protect and inherit these cultural heritages.
explanation: 本题考查被动语态和目的状语的用法。翻译时需注意：1. “面临失传的风险”译为are at risk of being lost，“失传”需用被动语态being lost，体现“手工艺被失传”的逻辑；2. “采取措施做某事”译为take measures to do sth，为四级核心结构；3. “传承”译为inherit，准确表达“将文化遗产传递下去”的含义，不可误译为pass（pass侧重“传递物品”，inherit更适合文化类传承的语境）。

content.stem: 中秋节是中国仅次于春节的第二大传统节日，其核心习俗是家人团聚、共赏明月。

answer: The Mid-Autumn Festival is the second largest traditional festival in China after the Spring Festival, and its core custom is family reunion and appreciating the bright moon together.
explanation: 本题考查序数词修饰名词的结构和表语的并列一致。翻译时需注意：1. “仅次于……的第二大”译为the second largest...after...，是四级翻译中表达排序的高频结构；2. “核心习俗”译为core custom，为准确表达文化类内容的词汇；3. 表语部分“家人团聚、共赏明月”需保持形式一致，译为family reunion（名词短语）和appreciating the bright moon together（动名词短语），避免出现名词与动词原形直接并列的语法错误，符合英文表语的逻辑要求。
kp_name: 序数词修饰名词与表语并列结构

content.stem: 为了缩小城乡教育资源差距，政府近年来投入大量资金建设乡村智慧校园。

answer: To narrow the gap in educational resources between urban and rural areas, the government has invested a large amount of money in building smart rural campuses in recent years.
explanation: 本题考查核心短语的准确翻译及时态运用。考点：1. 核心短语翻译：“缩小差距”译为“narrow the gap”，“城乡教育资源”译为“educational resources between urban and rural areas”，“智慧校园”译为“smart campus”；2. 时态：“近年来”（in recent years）为现在完成时的标志，故谓语动词“投入”译为“has invested”；3. 目的状语：“为了”译为不定式结构“To”引导目的状语，符合英文表达习惯。译文准确还原了原句的逻辑关系与语义，无语法错误。
kp_name: 目的状语翻译、现在完成时在翻译中的运用

content.stem: 人工智能技术正被广泛应用于个性化学习系统，为学生提供定制化的学习方案。

answer: Artificial intelligence technology is being widely applied to personalized learning systems to provide students with customized learning plans.
explanation: 本题考查被动语态翻译及非谓语动词作目的状语。考点：1. 被动语态：“正被广泛应用”为现在进行时的被动语态，译为“is being widely applied”，准确体现动作的进行性与被动关系；2. 核心术语翻译：“人工智能技术”译为“Artificial intelligence technology”，“个性化学习系统”译为“personalized learning systems”，“定制化的学习方案”译为“customized learning plans”；3. 目的逻辑：“为学生提供”译为不定式结构“to provide”作目的状语，清晰体现动作的目的。译文符合英文科技文本的简洁准确要求。
kp_name: 现在进行时被动语态翻译、非谓语动词作目的状语

content.stem: 许多高校建立了在线开放课程平台，使得优质教育资源能够被更多人获取。

answer: Many colleges and universities have established online open course platforms, making high-quality educational resources accessible to more people.
explanation: 本题考查结果状语的翻译及核心短语运用。考点：1. 时态：“建立了”为现在完成时，译为“have established”，体现动作对现在的影响；2. 结果状语：“使得”译为现在分词结构“making”引导结果状语，符合英文中用分词作结果状语的表达习惯；3. 核心短语：“在线开放课程平台”译为“online open course platforms”，“被更多人获取”译为“accessible to more people”，避免了生硬的被动结构，更符合英文科技文本的表达逻辑。译文准确还原了原句的因果关系。
kp_name: 现在分词作结果状语翻译、被动含义的灵活转换

content.stem: 尽管虚拟现实技术仍处于发展初期，它已经在职业教育领域展现出巨大的应用潜力。

answer: Although virtual reality technology is still in the early stage of development, it has shown great application potential in the field of vocational education.
explanation: 本题考查让步状语翻译及时态对比。考点：1. 让步状语：“尽管”译为“Although”引导让步状语从句，符合英文主从复合句的逻辑结构；2. 核心术语翻译：“虚拟现实技术”译为“virtual reality technology”，“发展初期”译为“the early stage of development”，“职业教育领域”译为“the field of vocational education”；3. 时态：从句“仍处于”为一般现在时“is”，主句“已经展现”为现在完成时“has shown”，准确体现“现阶段状态”与“动作对现在的影响”的时态对比。译文逻辑清晰，术语准确。
kp_name: 让步状语从句翻译、主从复合句时态搭配

content.stem: 随着大数据分析能力的提升，教育工作者能够更精准地识别学生的学习难点并调整教学策略。

answer: With the improvement of big data analysis capabilities, educators are able to more accurately identify students' learning difficulties and adjust teaching strategies accordingly.
explanation: 本题考查伴随状语翻译及副词位置。考点：1. 伴随状语：“随着”译为“With”引导名词短语作伴随状语，简洁体现动作发生的背景；2. 核心术语翻译：“大数据分析能力”译为“big data analysis capabilities”，“教育工作者”译为“educators”，“教学策略”译为“teaching strategies”；3. 副词位置：“更精准地”译为“more accurately”，置于动词短语“identify...and adjust”之前，符合英文副词修饰实义动词的位置规则；4. 逻辑补充：添加“accordingly”（相应地）体现“调整策略”与“识别难点”的逻辑关联，使译文更流畅。译文准确还原了原句的逻辑层次。
kp_name: With引导的伴随状语翻译、副词在实义动词前的位置规则

content.stem: 如果我们能合理利用科技手段优化教育模式，就有可能实现教育公平的长远目标。

answer: If we can make rational use of technological means to optimize the education model, it is possible to realize the long-term goal of educational equity.
explanation: 本题考查条件状语翻译及形式主语结构。考点：1. 条件状语：“如果”译为“If”引导真实条件状语从句，体现假设的合理性；2. 核心短语翻译：“合理利用”译为“make rational use of”，“科技手段”译为“technological means”，“教育公平”译为“educational equity”；3. 形式主语：“就有可能实现”译为“it is possible to realize”，用“it”作形式主语，避免句子头重脚轻，符合英文表达习惯；4. 目的逻辑：“优化教育模式”译为不定式结构“to optimize”作目的状语，清晰体现动作的目的。译文逻辑严谨，结构符合英文正式文本的要求。
kp_name: 真实条件状语翻译、形式主语结构的运用

content.stem: 中国的数字经济近年来保持快速增长，成为推动经济高质量发展的重要动力。

answer: China's digital economy has maintained rapid growth in recent years and has become an important driving force for promoting high-quality economic development.
explanation: 本题考查经济发展类基础表达的翻译。1. 核心短语翻译：“数字经济”译为“digital economy”，是经济领域固定术语；“快速增长”译为“rapid growth”；“高质量发展”译为“high-quality development”，均为官方标准译法。2. 时态处理：“近年来”提示动作从过去持续到现在，需用现在完成时“has maintained”；“成为”是“保持增长”的结果，因此用现在完成时的并列结构“has become”，符合动作的时间逻辑。3. 句式调整：将中文无主句转化为英文的主谓结构，使句子符合英文表达习惯。
kp_name: 经济类基础术语翻译、现在完成时的应用

content.stem: 地方政府出台多项政策，旨在吸引外资，促进区域产业升级。

answer: Local governments have introduced a number of policies aimed at attracting foreign investment and promoting regional industrial upgrading.
explanation: 本题考查经济政策类表达的翻译及非谓语结构的应用。1. 核心短语翻译：“出台政策”译为“introduced policies”；“吸引外资”译为“attracting foreign investment”；“区域产业升级”译为“regional industrial upgrading”，均为经济领域常用译法。2. 句式处理：中文“旨在”引导目的状语，英文可转化为过去分词短语“aimed at”作后置定语修饰“policies”，避免冗余；“吸引外资”和“促进区域产业升级”是并列目的，需保持动名词形式一致，符合英文平行结构要求。3. 时态：“出台多项政策”是过去发生且对现在有影响的动作，用现在完成时“have introduced”，符合语境。
kp_name: 经济政策类术语翻译、非谓语动词作定语的应用

content.stem: 随着全球供应链的重构，中国制造业正加快向智能化、绿色化转型。

answer: With the restructuring of the global supply chain, China's manufacturing industry is accelerating its transformation towards intelligence and green development.
explanation: 本题考查经济转型类表达的翻译及伴随状语的应用。1. 核心短语翻译：“全球供应链的重构”译为“the restructuring of the global supply chain”；“制造业”译为“manufacturing industry”；“智能化、绿色化转型”译为“transformation towards intelligence and green development”，其中“绿色化”转化为名词短语“green development”，符合英文抽象概念的表达习惯。2. 句式处理：中文“随着”引导伴随状语，英文用“With + 名词短语”的结构，简洁准确；“正加快”提示现在进行时“is accelerating”，体现动作的进行状态。3. 逻辑衔接：“向...转型”用“transformation towards”表达，明确转型的方向，符合经济领域的表述逻辑。
kp_name: 经济转型类术语翻译、伴随状语的应用

content.stem: 中小企业在吸纳就业、推动创新和活跃市场方面发挥着不可替代的作用。

answer: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) play an irreplaceable role in absorbing employment, promoting innovation and energizing the market.
explanation: 本题考查企业经济类表达的翻译及并列结构的应用。1. 核心短语翻译：“中小企业”译为“Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs)”，括号内为通用缩写，符合英文经济文本的规范；“吸纳就业”译为“absorbing employment”；“推动创新”译为“promoting innovation”；“活跃市场”译为“energizing the market”，其中“活跃”转化为动词“energize”，准确体现使市场充满活力的含义。2. 句式处理：中文“在...方面”译为“in + 动名词短语”的结构，三个并列的动名词短语需保持形式一致，符合英文平行结构的语法要求。3. 时态：“发挥着”是持续的状态，用一般现在时“play”，符合客观事实的表述。
kp_name: 企业经济类术语翻译、平行结构的应用

content.stem: 尽管面临贸易保护主义的挑战，中国仍坚持扩大高水平对外开放，为全球经济复苏贡献力量。

answer: Despite the challenges of trade protectionism, China still adheres to expanding high-level opening-up and contributes to the global economic recovery.
explanation: 本题考查国际经济类表达的翻译及让步状语的应用。1. 核心短语翻译：“贸易保护主义”译为“trade protectionism”；“扩大高水平对外开放”译为“expanding high-level opening-up”，是官方标准译法；“全球经济复苏”译为“the global economic recovery”。2. 句式处理：中文“尽管”引导让步状语，英文用“Despite + 名词短语”的结构，简洁明了；“坚持”译为“adheres to”，后接动名词“expanding”，符合动词的搭配要求；“贡献力量”译为“contributes to”，直接体现对全球经济复苏的作用，符合英文表达习惯。3. 逻辑衔接：句子前后为让步关系，通过“Despite”明确逻辑，使译文结构清晰。
kp_name: 国际经济类术语翻译、让步状语的应用

content.stem: 中国政府提出的共同富裕目标，旨在让全体人民共享经济发展的成果，缩小城乡、区域发展差距。

answer: The goal of common prosperity put forward by the Chinese government aims to enable all people to share the fruits of economic development and narrow the development gap between urban and rural areas and among regions.
explanation: 本题考查经济发展目标类表达的翻译及复杂定语的应用。1. 核心短语翻译：“共同富裕”译为“common prosperity”；“提出”译为“put forward”；“共享经济发展的成果”译为“share the fruits of economic development”；“城乡、区域发展差距”译为“the development gap between urban and rural areas and among regions”，其中“城乡”用“between”、“区域”用“among”，准确体现范围差异。2. 句式处理：中文“中国政府提出的共同富裕目标”是带有定语的名词短语，英文转化为“the goal of common prosperity put forward by the Chinese government”，用过去分词短语作后置定语，符合英文长定语的表达习惯；“旨在”译为“aims to”，后接两个并列的不定式短语“enable...and narrow...”，保持形式一致。3. 逻辑衔接：译文清晰体现“目标-目的-具体内容”的逻辑，结构严谨，符合经济政策文本的翻译要求。
kp_name: 经济发展目标类术语翻译、复杂定语的应用

content.stem: 为了保持健康，很多人现在养成了每天早起锻炼的习惯。

answer: To keep healthy, many people now have developed the habit of getting up early to exercise every day.
explanation: 考点：不定式作目的状语、动名词作介词宾语、固定搭配。1. 不定式作目的状语：“为了保持健康”表目的，需用不定式结构To keep healthy，不可用动词原形Keep；2. 固定搭配：“养成……的习惯”为固定表达develop the habit of，of是介词，后接动名词，因此“早起”译为getting up early；3. 时态：“现在养成了”表示动作对现在的影响，用现在完成时have developed符合语境。
kp_name: 不定式作目的状语、动名词作介词宾语、固定搭配

content.stem: 尽管智能手机很方便，但过度使用会对我们的视力造成伤害。

answer: Although smartphones are very convenient, overusing them can do harm to our eyesight.
explanation: 考点：让步状语从句、动名词作主语、固定搭配。1. 让步状语从句：“尽管”引导让步状语从句，可用Although或Though，注意从句需用陈述句语序；2. 动名词作主语：“过度使用”是动作作主语，需用动名词短语overusing them，不可用动词原形overuse；3. 固定搭配：“对……造成伤害”为固定表达do harm to，也可译为be harmful to，此处用do harm to符合日常表达习惯。
kp_name: 让步状语从句、动名词作主语、固定搭配

content.stem: 在周末，我通常会花几个小时整理房间，然后和朋友一起去看电影。

answer: On weekends, I usually spend a few hours tidying up my room and then go to the movies with my friends.
explanation: 考点：spend的用法、并列谓语、时间介词。1. spend的用法：“花时间做某事”为spend time (in) doing sth，因此“整理房间”译为tidying up my room，in可省略；2. 时间介词：“在周末”表示具体的时间点，用介词On，不可用In；3. 并列谓语：句子主语是I，两个动作“花时间整理”和“去看电影”是并列谓语，时态需一致，均用一般现在时，go to the movies符合日常表达。
kp_name: spend的用法、时间介词、并列谓语

content.stem: 越来越多的人开始选择在家做饭，而不是在外面吃快餐。

answer: More and more people are starting to choose to cook at home instead of eating fast food outside.
explanation: 考点：现在进行时表趋势、不定式作宾语、instead of的用法。1. 现在进行时表趋势：“越来越多的人开始选择”表示当前的趋势，用现在进行时are starting符合语境；2. 不定式作宾语：“选择做某事”为choose to do sth，因此“在家做饭”译为to cook at home；3. instead of的用法：instead of是介词短语，后接动名词，因此“在外面吃快餐”译为eating fast food outside，不可用动词原形eat。
kp_name: 现在进行时表趋势、不定式作宾语、instead of的用法

content.stem: 如果我们能合理安排时间，就能在工作和休闲之间找到平衡。

answer: If we can arrange our time properly, we can find a balance between work and leisure.
explanation: 考点：条件状语从句、情态动词、固定搭配。1. 条件状语从句：“如果”引导条件状语从句，遵循“主将从现”原则，此处从句用一般现在时arrange，主句用一般现在时can find；2. 情态动词：“能”表示能力，用情态动词can，后接动词原形；3. 固定搭配：“在……之间找到平衡”为固定表达find a balance between...and...，“合理安排时间”译为arrange our time properly，properly修饰动词arrange，位置正确。
kp_name: 条件状语从句、情态动词、固定搭配

content.stem: 由于最近天气变化无常，很多人都感冒了，不得不请假休息。

answer: Due to the recent changeable weather, many people have caught a cold and have had to ask for leave to rest.
explanation: 考点：原因状语、现在完成时、固定搭配。1. 原因状语：“由于”引导原因状语，此处“最近天气变化无常”是名词短语，用Due to（后接名词/名词短语），不可用Because（后接句子）；2. 现在完成时：“感冒了”表示动作对现在的影响（不得不请假），用现在完成时have caught a cold；3. 固定搭配：“不得不”为have to，此处用现在完成时have had to表示持续的状态，“请假”为固定表达ask for leave，“休息”用不定式to rest作目的状语。
kp_name: 原因状语、现在完成时、固定搭配

content.stem: 剪纸是中国传统民间艺术，已有超过1500年的历史。

answer: Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese folk art with a history of more than 1,500 years.
explanation: 考点：1. 核心名词短语的准确翻译：“剪纸”译为paper-cutting（固定表达，无需直译），“中国传统民间艺术”译为traditional Chinese folk art（形容词排序符合英文“性质+来源”的规则）；2. 伴随状语的使用：用with结构表达“已有...历史”，替代冗余的定语从句，符合英文简洁表达习惯。本题难度较低，核心考查传统文化类基础词汇的翻译及英文基本句式的运用。
kp_name: 传统文化类基础词汇翻译与英文句式结构

content.stem: 端午节是为了纪念古代诗人屈原而设立的。

answer: The Dragon Boat Festival was established to commemorate the ancient poet Qu Yuan.
explanation: 考点：1. 节日名称的标准译法：“端午节”译为The Dragon Boat Festival（专有名词首字母大写）；2. 被动语态的运用：“是为了...而设立”译为was established to...，符合英文“动作承受者作主语”的表达逻辑；3. 动词“纪念”的准确翻译：commemorate为正式语境的标准用词，区别于口语化的remember。本题难度中等偏易，核心考查传统文化类专有名词翻译及被动语态的使用。
kp_name: 传统文化类专有名词翻译与被动语态运用

content.stem: 中国书法不仅是一种书写艺术，还承载着丰富的文化内涵。

answer: Chinese calligraphy is not only a form of writing art but also carries rich cultural connotations.
explanation: 考点：1. 核心名词的准确翻译：“书法”译为calligraphy（特指书法艺术，区别于普通书写writing）；2. 并列结构的一致性：not only...but also...连接的两个谓语结构需保持逻辑与语法的平行性；3. 动词“承载”的翻译：carry在此处准确表达“蕴含、承载”的抽象含义，符合英文搭配习惯。本题难度中等，核心考查传统文化类抽象名词翻译及并列结构的运用。
kp_name: 传统文化类抽象名词翻译与并列结构运用

content.stem: 京剧以其独特的唱腔、服饰和表演风格闻名于世。

answer: Peking Opera is famous all over the world for its unique singing, costumes and performance styles.
explanation: 考点：1. 戏曲专有名词的标准译法：“京剧”译为Peking Opera（固定译法，不可译为Beijing Opera）；2. 原因状语的结构：“以...闻名”译为be famous for...，注意for后接名词性成分的并列；3. 并列名词的单复数：“唱腔”singing为不可数名词，“服饰”costumes、“表演风格”performance styles需用复数，符合英文名词数的规则。本题难度中等偏难，核心考查传统文化类专有名词翻译及名词数的一致性。
kp_name: 传统文化类戏曲专有名词翻译与名词数的一致性

content.stem: 中国传统医学强调人与自然的和谐统一，注重预防胜于治疗。

answer: Traditional Chinese medicine emphasizes the harmonious unity between humans and nature, and attaches importance to prevention over treatment.
explanation: 考点：1. 专有名词的准确翻译：“中国传统医学”译为Traditional Chinese medicine（缩写为TCM，此处用全称符合正式语境）；2. 抽象短语的翻译：“和谐统一”译为harmonious unity，“预防胜于治疗”译为prevention over treatment（符合英文“名词+over+名词”的对比结构）；3. 动词短语的平行性：“强调”emphasize与“注重”attach importance to为并列谓语，需保持时态一致。本题难度较高，核心考查传统文化类抽象概念翻译及并列谓语的一致性。
kp_name: 传统文化类抽象概念翻译与并列谓语一致性

content.stem: 春节期间，家人团聚，共享年夜饭，给孩子发压岁钱是重要的传统习俗。

answer: During the Spring Festival, it is an important traditional custom for families to gather, enjoy the New Year's Eve dinner and give children lucky money.
explanation: 考点：1. 复杂句式的整合：原句为多个并列动作作主语，英文用it作形式主语，真正主语为for families to...的不定式复合结构，避免头重脚轻；2. 核心习俗的准确翻译：“年夜饭”译为New Year's Eve dinner（固定表达），“压岁钱”译为lucky money（标准译法）；3. 并列不定式的一致性：gather、enjoy、give三个不定式动词需保持原形，符合形式主语结构的语法规则。本题难度最高，核心考查传统文化类复杂句式的整合及形式主语结构的运用。
kp_name: 传统文化类复杂句式翻译与形式主语结构运用

content.stem: The new policy is designed to ______ economic growth in the region.

explanation: promote 强调通过积极措施推动或促进某事物的发展，常与 growth、development 搭配；enhance 侧重提高价值、质量或吸引力；accelerate 强调速度加快；improve 指在原有基础上改进。此处与 economic growth 搭配，promote 最常用且自然。

content.stem: The scientist's research findings ______ the existing theory, leading to a major breakthrough.

explanation: refute 意为通过证据或论证驳斥、反驳，常指彻底否定某个理论或观点；contradict 仅表示与……相矛盾，不一定有论证过程；challenge 表示质疑或挑战，语气较弱；deny 指否认某事存在或真实性。此处强调研究结果推翻了原有理论，故 refute 最准确。

content.stem: The manager asked the employees to ______ their efforts to meet the deadline.

explanation: intensify 强调在强度、力度上加大，常与 effort、work 搭配；strengthen 使更强固或更有力；reinforce 指通过额外支持加强；consolidate 指合并或巩固。此处强调加大努力程度，intensify efforts 是固定搭配。

content.stem: The ancient temple has ______ the test of time and remains standing today.

explanation: withstand 意为经受住、承受（压力、攻击、时间等），常与 test、time 搭配；endure 指长期忍受痛苦或困难，但不如 withstand 强调成功抵抗；tolerate 指容忍或忍受不愉快；resist 指抵制或反抗。此处强调成功经受时间考验，withstand 最贴切。

content.stem: The politician's speech was designed to ______ the public's fears about the economic crisis.

explanation: alleviate 指减轻（痛苦、忧虑等），强调使程度降低，常与 fear、pain 搭配；relieve 侧重暂时解除不适或压力；mitigate 指使……缓和，多用于法律或正式语境；appease 指平息愤怒或满足要求。此处与 fears 搭配，alleviate 最常用且准确。

content.stem: The teacher tried to ______ the students' interest in classical literature.

explanation: arouse 意为引起、激发（兴趣、情感等），常与 interest、curiosity 搭配；rouse 指唤醒或激励行动，更强调动作；evoke 指唤起记忆或情感，较抽象；inspire 指鼓舞或启示。此处与 interest 搭配，arouse 是最佳选择。

content.stem: The company's profits have ______ significantly due to the new marketing strategy.

explanation: skyrocket 意为急剧上升、飞涨，常强调突然且大幅增长，多用于利润、价格等；soar 指快速上升，但不如 skyrocket 强烈；surge 指汹涌或激增，常用于波浪或情绪；escalate 指逐步升级。此处强调利润因策略大幅上涨，skyrocket 语气最强且最形象。

content.stem: The two countries signed a treaty to ______ their economic cooperation.

explanation: consolidate 意为巩固、合并，常指将分散的事物联合成一体以增强，用于合作、关系等；strengthen 指增强力量或强度；solidify 指使变硬或固化，引申为巩固；cement 指用水泥粘合，喻指加强关系。此处强调通过条约使合作更稳固，consolidate 最正式且贴切。

由于缺乏经验，他在处理这个复杂问题时感到有些力不从心。

content.stem:
The government launched a campaign to raise public awareness of environmental protection. 
（提示：请翻译“campaign”，注意区分 campaign, movement, activity 等近义词）

answer: 参考译文：政府发起了一场提高公众环保意识的活动。

content.stem:
他的建议虽然听起来简单，但实际上需要大量的准备工作。

content.stem:
The scientist spent years studying the subtle differences between the two species.

answer: 参考译文：这位科学家花了数年时间研究这两个物种之间的细微差异。
knowledge_point: 近义词辨析：subtle (微妙的，难以察觉的) vs. delicate (精致的，需小心处理的) vs. slight (轻微的，程度小)

content.stem:
尽管面临重重困难，他仍然坚持自己的信念，从未动摇。
（提示：请翻译“坚持”，注意区分 persist, insist, persevere 等近义词）

answer: 参考译文：Despite numerous difficulties, he still persisted in his beliefs and never wavered.
knowledge_point: 近义词辨析：persist in (坚持做某事，常含固执意味) vs. insist on (坚决主张/要求) vs. persevere in (坚持不懈，褒义)

content.stem:
The company's new policy aims to enhance employee satisfaction and productivity. 
（提示：请翻译“enhance”，注意区分 enhance, improve, increase 等近义词）

answer: 参考译文：公司的新政策旨在提高员工满意度和生产力。
knowledge_point: 近义词辨析：enhance (增强、提升，常指价值、质量等抽象事物) vs. improve (改善，使变得更好) vs. increase (增加数量或程度)

content.stem:
这位作家以其独特的风格在文学界享有盛誉，他的作品影响了一代人。
（提示：请翻译“影响”，注意区分 affect, influence, impact 等近义词）

answer: 参考译文：This writer enjoys a high reputation in the literary world for his unique style, and his works have influenced a generation.
knowledge_point: 近义词辨析：influence (潜移默化的影响，常含正面或中性) vs. affect (影响，多指情感或结果) vs. impact (强烈冲击，常指重大影响)

content.stem:
The rapid development of technology has fundamentally altered the way we communicate. 
（提示：请翻译“altered”，注意区分 alter, change, modify 等近义词）

answer: 参考译文：技术的快速发展从根本上改变了我们交流的方式。

content.stem: The government has taken measures to ______ the spread of the virus, including travel restrictions and mass testing.

explanation: contain 在此意为“控制，抑制（蔓延）”，符合政府采取措施抑制病毒传播的语境。sustain（维持）、promote（促进）、accelerate（加速）均与句意相反或不当。

content.stem: His ______ to detail made him an excellent editor, but it also slowed down his work pace.

explanation: 短语 attention to detail 是固定搭配，意为“对细节的关注”。attitude（态度）常接towards/to；contribution（贡献）接to；affection（喜爱）接for，均不适用。

content.stem: It is ______ that the project will be completed by the end of this month, as all the team members are working overtime.

explanation: likely 作形容词意为“可能的”，用于 It is likely that... 句型。rarely（很少）、hardly（几乎不）、merely（仅仅）均为副词，不能用于该句型。

content.stem: The new policy aims to ______ the gap between the rich and the poor by providing more job opportunities.

explanation: narrow the gap 是固定搭配，意为“缩小差距”。widen（扩大）、ignore（忽视）、maintain（维持）均与政策目的（缩小贫富差距）相反或不符。

content.stem: The professor ______ that the students read the original text rather than the simplified version.

explanation: recommend 后接 that 从句时，从句用虚拟语气（should + 动词原形），意为“建议”。command（命令）、demand（要求）、insist（坚持）语气过强，不符合教授提出建议的语境。

content.stem: Despite the ______ weather conditions, the rescue team managed to reach the stranded hikers.

content.stem: She decided to ______ the job offer because the salary was too low.

explanation: decline 意为“婉拒，谢绝”，符合因薪水低而拒绝工作邀请的语境。accept（接受）与原因矛盾；ignore（忽视）不表示主动拒绝；delay（推迟）未明确拒绝。

content.stem: The research findings ______ the theory that early childhood experiences shape adult personality.

explanation: support 在此意为“支持，证实”，符合研究结果与理论一致的逻辑。challenge（挑战）表示否定，与“findings”的正面作用不符；ignore（忽视）和predict（预测）均不准确。

content.stem: The government has taken measures to ______ the spread of the virus.

explanation: contain 在此意为‘控制、抑制’，符合‘控制病毒传播’的语境。sustain 意为‘维持’，retain 意为‘保留’，attain 意为‘达到’，均不符合句意。

content.stem: The new policy will ______ significant changes in the education system.

explanation: bring about 意为‘引起、导致’，与‘significant changes’搭配恰当。bring up 意为‘抚养、提出’，bring in 意为‘引入、赚得’，bring out 意为‘出版、使显现’，均不合题意。

content.stem: The scientist's research has ______ a new understanding of the disease.

explanation: contribute to 意为‘有助于、促成’，符合‘研究促成了新认识’的语境。attribute to 意为‘归因于’，distribute to 意为‘分配给’，tributed 不是标准动词，均错误。

content.stem: She was ______ by the beauty of the sunset and couldn't move.

explanation: fascinated 意为‘着迷的’，与‘beauty of sunset’搭配合理。frustrated 意为‘沮丧的’，fabricated 意为‘伪造的’，fragmented 意为‘破碎的’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: The company is trying to ______ its market share by launching new products.

explanation: expand 意为‘扩大、扩展’，常与‘market share’搭配表示‘扩大市场份额’。expend 意为‘花费’，extend 意为‘延伸’，expose 意为‘暴露’，均不合题意。

content.stem: The politician's speech was full of ______ remarks that offended many people.

explanation: controversial 意为‘有争议的’，与‘offended many people’逻辑一致。contradictory 意为‘矛盾的’，conventional 意为‘传统的’，convincing 意为‘令人信服的’，均不匹配‘冒犯他人’的后果。

content.stem: He ______ his success to hard work and determination.

explanation: owe...to... 是固定搭配，意为‘把……归功于’，符合‘把成功归因于努力’的语境。own 意为‘拥有’，offer 意为‘提供’，open 意为‘打开’，均不能与to构成此搭配。

content.stem: The accident ______ a series of events that led to the company's bankruptcy.

explanation: trigger 意为‘触发、引发’，与‘a series of events’搭配合理。trace 意为‘追踪’，transfer 意为‘转移’，transform 意为‘转变’，均不符合‘引发一系列事件’的语境。

explanation: contain有‘控制、抑制’之意，符合句意‘控制疫情传播’。confess意为‘承认、坦白’，complain意为‘抱怨’，consume意为‘消费、消耗’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: The new policy will ______ significant changes in the education system.

explanation: bring about意为‘引起、导致’，符合句意‘带来重大变化’。bring up意为‘抚养、提出’，bring out意为‘出版、使显现’，bring in意为‘引进、赚钱’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: He was ______ from school for cheating on the exam.

explanation: expel意为‘开除、驱逐’，常用于学校开除学生。exclude意为‘排除、排斥’，exceed意为‘超过’，excel意为‘擅长、胜过’，均不符合句意。

content.stem: The manager tried to ______ the employees to work harder by offering bonuses.

explanation: motivate意为‘激励、激发’，符合句意‘激励员工更努力工作’。monitor意为‘监控’，modify意为‘修改’，multiply意为‘乘以、繁殖’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: The research findings ______ the theory that exercise improves mental health.

explanation: confirm意为‘证实、确认’，符合句意‘证实了该理论’。conform意为‘遵守、符合’，常与to搭配；confine意为‘限制’，confuse意为‘使困惑’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: She ______ her success to hard work and determination.

explanation: attribute...to...意为‘把……归因于’，符合句意‘她把成功归因于努力和决心’。contribute to意为‘有助于、捐献’，distribute意为‘分配’，tribute为名词意为‘贡品’，均不符合用法。

content.stem: The company is ______ to expand its business overseas next year.

explanation: likely意为‘可能的’，常用结构be likely to do sth.，符合句意‘公司很可能明年拓展海外业务’。liable意为‘有责任的、易于……的’，但语气偏负面；friendly意为‘友好的’，lively意为‘活泼的’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: The two countries have ______ a trade agreement after months of negotiation.

explanation: sign意为‘签署’，符合句意‘签署贸易协议’。design意为‘设计’，assign意为‘分配、指派’，resign意为‘辞职’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: The government is taking measures to ______ the spread of the virus.

explanation: 考查形近词辨析。contain意为‘控制、遏制’，符合‘控制病毒传播’的语境。content作动词意为‘使满足’，contest意为‘竞争、质疑’，contact意为‘联系’，均不符合句意。

content.stem: His speech was so ______ that everyone was moved to tears.

explanation: 根据‘moved to tears’可知演讲令人感动，inspiring意为‘鼓舞人心的’。insulting意为‘侮辱的’，insisting意为‘坚持的’，insulating意为‘绝缘的’，均不符合语境。

content.stem: Many people ______ that the new policy will bring about positive changes.

explanation: assume意为‘假设、认为’，符合‘人们认为新政策会带来积极变化’。resume意为‘重新开始’，consume意为‘消费’，presume意为‘假定（通常指无证据）’，但assume更常用且中性。

content.stem: The company is trying to ______ its market share by launching new products.

explanation: expand意为‘扩大（规模、范围）’，expand market share是常见搭配。extend意为‘延伸（时间或空间）’，expend意为‘花费（时间、金钱）’，expose意为‘暴露’，均不搭配market share。

content.stem: The professor's ______ explanation helped the students understand the complex theory.

explanation: elaborate意为‘详细的、精心制作的’，修饰explanation表示‘详细的解释’。elegant意为‘优雅的’，eligible意为‘合格的’，elementary意为‘基础的’，不符合‘帮助理解复杂理论’的语境。

content.stem: She ______ her success to hard work and perseverance.

explanation: attribute...to...意为‘把……归因于’，固定搭配。contribute to意为‘贡献’，distribute意为‘分配’，tribute是名词意为‘致敬’，无tributed一词。

content.stem: The report ______ the urgent need for environmental protection.

explanation: underline意为‘强调、突出’，符合‘报告强调环境保护的紧迫需求’。undermine意为‘削弱’，underestimate意为‘低估’，undertake意为‘承担’，均不符合句意。

content.stem: It is ______ that the project will be completed on time.

explanation: It is likely that...意为‘很可能……’，固定句型。alike意为‘相像的’，like作介词或动词，unlike意为‘不像’，均不能用于此句型。

content: The government has taken measures to ______ the spread of the epidemic.

content.stem: The new policy will ______ significant changes in the company's management structure.

explanation: bring about 意为“引起，导致”，符合句意“新政策将引起公司管理结构的重大变化”。bring up 意为“抚养；提出”；bring in 意为“引入；赚得”；bring out 意为“出版；使显现”。

content.stem: It is essential that every student ______ the safety regulations during the experiment.

explanation: observe 在此意为“遵守（规则、法律等）”，常用于正式语境，如 observe regulations。obey 强调服从命令或权威；follow 是通用词，但不如 observe 正式；comply 需接 with 才能接宾语。

content.stem: The scientist's research findings were ______ by several independent laboratories.

explanation: confirm 意为“证实，确认”，符合句意“研究结果被多个独立实验室证实”。conform 意为“遵守，符合”；confine 意为“限制”；confuse 意为“使困惑”。四个词形近但意义不同。

content.stem: The manager tried to ______ the conflict between the two departments by arranging a meeting.

explanation: resolve 意为“解决（问题、冲突等）”，符合句意“经理试图通过安排会议解决两个部门之间的冲突”。revolve 意为“旋转”；involve 意为“涉及”；dissolve 意为“溶解；解散”。

content.stem: The government has taken measures to ______ the spread of the infectious disease.

explanation: restrict 意为“限制，约束”，常与 spread 搭配，表示“限制传播”。restrain 强调“抑制（情绪或行为）”；refrain 是不及物动词，需接 from，意为“克制”；retain 意为“保留”。

content.stem: She was deeply ______ by the news of her friend's accident.

explanation: affect 意为“影响；感动”，符合句意“她被朋友出事的消息深深感动/影响”。effect 作动词时意为“实现，引起”；infect 意为“感染”；defect 意为“背叛”。

content.stem: The company's decision to ______ the old factory was met with strong opposition from the workers.

explanation: demolish 意为“拆除，摧毁（建筑物）”，符合句意“拆除旧工厂的决定”。abolish 意为“废除（法律、制度等）”；polish 意为“抛光，擦亮”；vanish 意为“消失”，为不及物动词。

content.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that many students fell asleep.

explanation: tedious 意为“冗长乏味的”，符合句意“讲座太乏味，许多学生睡着了”。temporary 意为“暂时的”；tempting 意为“诱人的”；tender 意为“温柔的；嫩的”。

content.stem: The new policy is designed to _____ the efficiency of the manufacturing process, while also _____ the environmental impact of industrial waste.
By the time you finish reading this book, you ______ a thorough understanding of the subject.

explanation: 本题考查将来完成时。时间状语“By the time you finish reading this book”表示到将来某个时间点（你读完这本书时）之前，动作已完成。将来完成时的结构为“will have + 过去分词”。选项A正确。选项B是现在完成时，与将来时间不匹配；选项C是一般将来时，强调将来某个时刻会发生，但未强调在将来某时间点前完成；选项D是一般过去时，与将来语境不符。

content.stem: It is reported that a new subway line ______ in the city by the end of next year.

explanation: 本题考查将来完成时的被动语态。时间状语“by the end of next year”表示到明年年底之前，动作“完成”将已经发生，且“地铁线”是被完成的，因此需用将来完成时的被动语态（will have been + 过去分词）。选项B正确。选项A是一般将来时的被动语态，强调将来某个时间被完成，但未强调“到某时间点之前已完成”；选项C是一般现在时的被动语态，表示经常或事实；选项D是现在完成时的被动语态，表示到现在为止已完成，与将来时间不符。

content.stem: She ______ for the company for five years before she decided to start her own business.

explanation: 本题考查过去完成时。句中“before she decided to start her own business”是过去的时间点，而“工作五年”发生在该时间点之前，即“过去的过去”，因此需用过去完成时（had + 过去分词）。选项B正确。选项A是现在完成时，与过去语境不符；选项C是一般过去时，无法体现动作的先后顺序；选项D是过去进行时，强调在过去某段时间正在进行的动作，但此处强调动作已完成。

content.stem: The experiment ______ at the moment, so we cannot enter the laboratory.

explanation: 本题考查现在进行时的被动语态。时间状语“at the moment”表示此刻正在进行的动作，且实验是被进行的，因此需用现在进行时的被动语态（is/am/are being + 过去分词）。选项A正确。选项B是现在完成时的被动语态，表示已经完成，与“正在”矛盾；选项C是一般过去时的被动语态，表示过去发生的动作；选项D是一般将来时的被动语态，表示将来发生的动作。

content.stem: I ______ to the party last night, but I had to finish my report.

explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气中与过去事实相反的用法。句意为“我昨晚本想去派对，但我必须完成报告”，实际并未去，表示对过去情况的虚拟。主句应用“would have + 过去分词”表示与过去事实相反的愿望或结果。选项B正确。选项A是过去将来时或虚拟语气中与现在/将来事实相反的用法，不符合过去语境；选项C是一般过去时，表示确实去了，与句意矛盾；选项D是过去完成时，表示动作发生在“昨晚”之前，不符合逻辑。

content.stem: Every time he ______ to the museum, he spends hours in the ancient art section.

explanation: 本题考查一般现在时表示习惯性动作。时间状语“Every time”引导的从句表示每次发生的动作，主句用一般现在时“spends”表示习惯，从句也应用一般现在时，保持时态一致。选项A正确。选项B是一般过去时，与主句现在时态不一致；选项C是现在完成时，强调动作结果或经验，不符合习惯性语境；选项D是将来时，与主句现在时态不匹配。

content.stem: The manager insisted that the report ______ before the deadline.

explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气在宾语从句中的用法。动词“insist”表示“坚持要求”时，其后的that从句需用虚拟语气，即“(should) + 动词原形”，被动语态为“(should) be + 过去分词”。选项A中省略了should，符合语法。选项B中“must”语气过强，且不是虚拟语气标准结构；选项C是一般现在时的被动语态，不符合虚拟语气要求；选项D是一般过去时的被动语态，表示事实，但此处为要求，不是事实描述。

content.stem: While I ______ my homework, my mother was cooking dinner.

explanation: 本题考查过去进行时。句中“while”引导的时间状语从句表示两个动作同时进行，且“做作业”和“做饭”都是过去持续的动作，因此从句和主句均应用过去进行时（was/were + 现在分词）。选项B正确。选项A是一般过去时，强调动作完成，不强调持续进行；选项C是现在完成时，与过去语境不符；选项D是过去完成时，表示动作发生在另一个过去动作之前，不符合同时进行的逻辑。

content.stem: By the time the rescue team arrived, the injured hiker _______ for nearly two days in the freezing cold. They _______ him to a nearby hospital immediately.

question: By the time he arrives at the airport, the plane ______ for two hours.
explanation: by the time引导时间状语从句，主句常用完成时。若从句为一般现在时（arrives），主句用将来完成时（will have taken off）；若从句为一般过去时，主句用过去完成时（had taken off）。此处从句为一般现在时，故A正确；但D在特定上下文（如转述过去计划）也可成立，因此A和D均为可能答案。

question: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
explanation: 在It is the first time that...结构中，从句通常用现在完成时（have seen）；若主句为was，则从句用过去完成时（had seen）。此处主句为is，故B正确；但若语境为过去叙述，D也可接受。

question: The experiment ______ before the professor came into the lab.
explanation: before引导时间状语从句，主句动作发生在从句之前，可用过去完成时（had been completed）强调先时性；也可用一般过去时（was completed）仅陈述事实。D为主动语态，不符合被动含义；C时态不符。

question: She told me that she ______ the book for three weeks.
explanation: 在间接引语中，主句为过去时（told），从句需用相应的过去时态。for three weeks表示持续，可用过去完成进行时（had been reading）强调持续；也可用过去完成时（had read）强调完成。B、C时态错误。

question: The bridge ______ by the time we arrived at the village.
explanation: by the time + 过去时（arrived），主句可用过去完成时被动（had already been built）表示在到达前已完成；也可用一般过去时被动（was already built）表示当时状态。C时态错误，D为主动语态且不完整。

question: He ______ in this company since he graduated from college.
explanation: since引导时间状语，主句常用现在完成时（has worked）或现在完成进行时（has been working），前者强调事实，后者强调持续。一般过去时（worked）和过去完成时（had worked）均不符合since的时态要求。

question: The letter ______ by the time you get back.
explanation: by the time + 一般现在时（get back），主句可用将来完成时被动（will have been written）表示在将来某时前完成；也可用一般将来时被动（will be written）表示将来动作。C、D时态与从句不一致。

question: I wish I ______ harder for the final exam last semester.
explanation: wish后接过去时间（last semester），表示与过去事实相反的愿望，用过去完成时（had studied）或could have + 过去分词（could have studied）。B为一般过去时表虚拟语气不标准；D时态错误。

content.stem: 自从去年搬到这个城市以来，他一直在学习如何适应快节奏的生活。

answer: He has been learning how to adapt to the fast-paced life since he moved to this city last year.

content.stem: By the time you finish reading this book, you ______ a thorough understanding of the subject.

explanation: 本题考查将来完成时。时间状语“By the time you finish reading this book”表示“到你读完这本书的时候”，强调在将来某个时间点之前完成的动作，因此主句需用将来完成时“will have gained”。选项B“will gain”是一般将来时，只表示将来动作，未强调完成；选项C“have gained”是现在完成时，与将来时间状语不搭配；选项D“are gaining”是现在进行时，不符合语境。

content.stem: The experiment ______ out last month, but the results have not been analyzed yet.

explanation: 本题考查一般过去时的被动语态。主语“The experiment”与动词“carry out”之间是被动关系（实验被进行），且时间状语“last month”表示过去，故用一般过去时的被动语态“was carried”。选项A“carried”是主动语态，不符合被动关系；选项C“has carried”是现在完成时主动语态，时态与“last month”冲突；选项D“had been carried”是过去完成时被动语态，但句中无明确过去时间点作为参照，且“last month”直接指向一般过去时，不需要用过去完成时。

content.stem: She ______ English for ten years by the time she graduates from college.

explanation: 本题考查将来完成进行时。时间状语“by the time she graduates from college”表示“到她大学毕业时”，强调动作从过去持续到将来某个时间点，且可能仍在进行，因此用将来完成进行时“will have been studying”。选项A“has studied”是现在完成时，与将来时间状语不匹配；选项C“had studied”是过去完成时，表示过去的过去，不符合语境；选项D“is studying”是现在进行时，无法表达持续到将来的含义。

content.stem: The manager insisted that the work ______ before Friday.

explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气在宾语从句中的用法。动词“insist”表示“坚持要求”时，后接的宾语从句需用虚拟语气，即“(should) + 动词原形”，且主语“the work”与动词“finish”之间是被动关系，故用“(should) be finished”，此处省略了“should”。选项A“must be finished”虽含被动，但“must”不符合虚拟语气结构；选项C“should finish”为主动语态，且“should”虽可保留，但语态错误；选项D“would be finished”是过去将来时的被动，不用于虚拟语气。

content.stem: I would have called you yesterday, but I ______ your phone number.

explanation: 本题考查虚拟语气与真实情况的混合时态。前半句“I would have called you yesterday”是对过去的虚拟假设（本应做而未做），后半句“but”引出真实情况，表示“但（当时）我忘了你的电话号码”，强调过去发生的真实动作，故用一般过去时“forgot”。选项A“have forgotten”是现在完成时，强调对现在的影响，但语境中“yesterday”明确指向过去；选项B“had forgotten”是过去完成时，但句中无过去时间点作为参照，且忘记发生在打电话之前，但虚拟语气中真实部分通常用一般过去时；选项D“was forgetting”是过去进行时，不表示瞬间遗忘的动作。

content.stem: The new bridge ______ by the end of next year.

explanation: 本题考查一般将来时的被动语态。主语“The new bridge”与动词“complete”之间是被动关系，且时间状语“by the end of next year”表示将来时间点，因此用一般将来时的被动语态“will be completed”。选项A“will complete”是主动语态，错误；选项C“has been completed”是现在完成时被动，与“next year”矛盾；选项D“is completed”是一般现在时被动，表示经常性或客观事实，不符合将来时间。

content.stem: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful sunset.

explanation: 本题考查固定句型中的时态。句型“It is the first time that...”中，that从句通常使用现在完成时，表示“这是第一次做某事”，强调经历。因此应选“have seen”。选项A“see”是一般现在时，不符合句型要求；选项B“saw”是一般过去时，但该句型强调与现在的关联；选项D“had seen”是过去完成时，若主句为“It was the first time”才用过去完成时，此处主句为“It is”，故用现在完成时。

content.stem: The children ______ very quiet. I wonder what they are up to.

explanation: 本题考查进行时态表示暂时性或特定行为。句意为“孩子们现在很安静”，强调他们此刻的行为表现，而非一贯性格，因此用现在进行时“are being”表示“（此刻）表现得很安静”。选项B“are”是一般现在时，表示常态或事实，但此处暗示反常情况，故不适用；选项C“have been”是现在完成时，强调从过去到现在一直安静，但语境强调此刻的异常；选项D“were”是过去时，与后文“I wonder what they are up to”的现在时态不协调。

content.stem: By the time he arrives, the meeting ______ (already/start) for about ten minutes.

explanation: 本题考查将来完成时。句意：当他到达机场时，飞机已经起飞半小时了。by the time引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表示将来，主句动作“起飞”发生在将来某个时间点之前并持续到该时间点，故用将来完成时will have done。B选项是一般将来时，表示将来动作，不强调完成；C选项是现在完成时，与过去相关；D选项是过去完成时，与过去时间点对应，均不符合语境。

content.stem: The new bridge ______ by the end of next year, according to the official plan.

explanation: 本题考查将来时态的被动语态。句意：根据官方计划，这座新桥将在明年年底前建成。桥是“被建成”，需用被动语态；时间状语“by the end of next year”表示将来某个时间点之前完成，所以用将来时的被动语态will be completed。A选项是主动形式，不符合逻辑；C选项是现在完成时被动，与将来时间不符；D选项是一般现在时被动，表示通常情况，不表将来。

content.stem: I ______ my homework when my mother came back home yesterday evening.

explanation: 本题考查过去进行时。句意：昨晚我妈妈回家时，我正在做作业。when引导的时间状语从句用一般过去时，主句表示在过去某个时间点（妈妈回家时）正在进行的动作，所以用过去进行时was doing。A选项是一般过去时，表示完成的动作，不强调进行；C选项是现在完成时，与过去无关；D选项是过去完成时，表示“过去的过去”，但句中无先后顺序强调。

content.stem: It is the first time that I ______ such a wonderful movie.

explanation: 本题考查固定句型中的时态。句型“It is the first time that...”中，从句通常用现在完成时，表示“这是第一次做某事”。句意：这是我第一次看这么精彩的电影。A选项是一般过去时，不符合该句型要求；B选项是一般现在时，不用于此结构；D选项是过去完成时，用于“It was the first time that...”句型。

content.stem: The experiment ______ for three months before we got the final results.

explanation: 本题考查过去完成时的被动语态。句意：在我们得到最终结果之前，这个实验已经进行了三个月。动作“进行实验”发生在“得到结果”之前，而“得到结果”是过去时，所以“进行实验”是“过去的过去”，用过去完成时；且实验是被进行的，用被动语态。A选项是现在完成时，与过去时间点不符；C选项是一般过去时被动，不强调先后顺序；D选项是现在进行时被动，与语境无关。

content.stem: Look! The children ______ happily in the garden.

explanation: 本题考查现在进行时。句意：看！孩子们正在花园里开心地玩耍。提示词“Look!”强调此刻正在发生的动作，所以用现在进行时are playing。A选项是一般现在时，表示经常性动作；C选项是现在完成时，强调结果或经历；D选项是一般过去时，表示过去动作，均不匹配。

content.stem: He ______ for the company for 20 years by the time he retires next year.

explanation: 本题考查将来完成时。句意：到明年他退休时，他将已经为这家公司工作了20年。时间状语“by the time he retires next year”表示到将来某个时间点为止，动作“工作”将持续并完成，所以用将来完成时will have worked。A选项是一般将来时，不强调完成状态；C选项是现在完成时，与将来时间无关；D选项是过去完成时，用于过去语境。

content.stem: The classroom ______ every day by the students on duty.

explanation: 本题考查一般现在时的被动语态。句意：教室每天由值日生打扫。主语“教室”是动作“打扫”的承受者，需用被动语态；时间状语“every day”表示经常性动作，用一般现在时。A选项是主动形式，不符合逻辑；C选项是现在完成时主动，不匹配；D选项是一般过去时被动，但句中无过去时间提示。

answer: By the end of last month, they had completed half of the project.

content.knowledge_point: 现在进行时的被动语态

answer: The bridge is being built currently and is expected to open to traffic next year.

content.knowledge_point: 一般现在时表将来（条件状语从句）

answer: If it rains tomorrow, the sports meeting will be postponed.

content.stem: 自从她去年毕业以来，她一直在一家跨国公司工作。

answer: She has been working in a multinational company since she graduated last year.

answer: 据说这个问题昨天已经在会议上被讨论过了。

answer: When he arrived at the airport, the plane had already taken off.
